### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest#TearSheet

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

```typescript
export interface TearSheet {
    performance: PerformanceSummary;
    trades: TradeStatistics;
    returns: ReturnStatistics;
    attribution: SymbolAttribution[];
    monteCarlo?: MonteCarloResampleResult;
    /** The source backtest's echoed modelling assumptions — a tear sheet never drops them (WS2.8). */
    assumptions: BacktestAssumptions;
    /** The source backtest's implementation-risk diagnostics — a tear sheet never drops them (WS2.8). */
    diagnostics: ImplementationRisk;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- assumptions: BacktestAssumptions; default: not declared — The source backtest's echoed modelling assumptions — a tear sheet never drops them (WS2.8).
- assumptions.assignment?: string; default: not declared — American early exercise/assignment policy: `model` or `none` (WS7.4). Absent where inapplicable.
- assumptions.calendar: string; default: not declared — Rebalancing/trading calendar, e.g. `every-bar`, `monthly`, `signal-driven`.
- assumptions.cashSettlement: string; default: not declared — Cash settlement assumption, e.g. `immediate` (T+0).
- assumptions.conventionsVersion: string; default: not declared — Version of the library's default conventions (core `CONVENTIONS_VERSION`).
- assumptions.corporateAction: string; default: not declared — Corporate-action handling, e.g. `dividends-as-cash`, `splits-adjusted`, `none`.
- assumptions.cost: string; default: not declared — Commission model applied, e.g. `bps(1)`, `per-share(0.005)`, `none`.
- assumptions.fill: string; default: not declared — When/at what price orders fill, e.g. `next-open`, `close`, `trigger-price`.
- assumptions.initialCapital: number; default: not declared — Opening capital the run started from.
- assumptions.margin: string; default: not declared — Leverage/margin regime: `unconstrained` (no cap; unfunded fills allowed) or `maxLeverage`.
- assumptions.oco?: string; default: not declared — How an OCO group resolves a bar that touches BOTH legs. One bar cannot say which trigger came
first, and the engine's answer — the take-profit, because a bracket submits it before the
stop-loss and orders fill in submission order — is optimistic. It is disclosed here rather than
left as an undocumented mechanic (`take-profit-first-on-ambiguous-bar`). Absent for engines with
no order book (the vectorized loop).
- assumptions.slippage: string; default: not declared — Slippage model applied, e.g. `bps(2)`, `spread`, `none`.
- attribution: SymbolAttribution[]; default: not declared
- diagnostics: ImplementationRisk; default: not declared — The source backtest's implementation-risk diagnostics — a tear sheet never drops them (WS2.8).
- diagnostics.autoReason?: string; default: not declared — When a meta-engine (e.g. `engines.auto()`) selected a delegate, this is a one-sentence,
human-readable explanation of WHY that delegate was chosen (`engine` then names the delegate).
Absent when no auto-selection took place.
- diagnostics.benchmarkFixtureVersion: string; default: not declared — The benchmark fixture version this engine was validated against.
- diagnostics.converged?: boolean; default: not declared — Whether an iterative procedure converged. `false` means the value is not trustworthy.
- diagnostics.decomposition?: Record<string, number>; default: not declared — Named intermediate quantities the value decomposes into — a par spread's protection leg and
risky annuity, a forward variance's near/far legs. The H-series explain paths disclose their
arithmetic here so a caller can audit the ratio, not just receive it (3B.3).
- diagnostics.engine?: string; default: not declared — Pricing/solver engine name, e.g. `black-scholes-merton`.
- diagnostics.finiteDifferenceBumps?: Record<string, number>; default: not declared — Finite-difference engines: the ACTUAL bump sizes used for FD Greeks (spec P2.3) — adaptive
near the vol/time boundaries, so the caller can see exactly what was differenced.
Keys: `spotStep`, `volatilityStep`, `timeStepYears`, `rateStep`, and — extended Greeks only —
`dividendYieldStep`. Each is the actual step differenced, in the unit of the coordinate it
bumps. (This doc named the retired `hS`/`hSig`/`hT`/`hR`/`hQ` keys for one release after the
emit sites had moved to the semantic names, so a caller following it read `undefined`.)
- diagnostics.iterations?: number; default: not declared — Iteration count for iterative methods.
- diagnostics.method?: string; default: not declared — Numerical method, e.g. `closed-form`, `brent`, `finite-difference`.
- diagnostics.selection?: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing').SelectionReport; default: not declared — The structured engine-selection report (Gate C, `@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing`): who was selected,
why, and — for automatic selection — every candidate considered with its verdict. This is the
machine-readable superset of `engine` + `autoReason` (which remain for compatibility);
`selected.name` always agrees with `engine` when both are present.
- diagnostics.selection.candidates?: readonly import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing').SelectionCandidate[]; default: not declared — Candidates an automatic selection considered; absent for explicit mode.
- diagnostics.selection.mode: 'explicit' | 'automatic'; default: not declared
- diagnostics.selection.reason: string; default: not declared — Why the selected engine answers this request.
- diagnostics.selection.selected: { name: string; version?: string; }; default: not declared
- diagnostics.selection.selected.name: string; default: not declared
- diagnostics.selection.selected.version?: string; default: not declared
- diagnostics.timingMs?: number; default: not declared — Wall-clock timing in milliseconds, when measured.
- diagnostics.warmup?: number; default: not declared — Series facades: number of leading output slots that are warmup sentinels (null/NaN) while the
computation seeds. Equals the input length when the indicator never emitted.
- diagnostics.warnings: QuantWarning[]; default: not declared — Structured warnings; always present (possibly empty).
- monteCarlo?: MonteCarloResampleResult; default: not declared
- monteCarlo.confidenceInterval95: [number, number]; default: not declared — 95% percentile interval of the total return across resamples.
- monteCarlo.iterations: number; default: not declared
- monteCarlo.meanTotalReturn: number; default: not declared — Mean bootstrapped total return.
- monteCarlo.seed: number; default: not declared
- monteCarlo.standardDeviation: number; default: not declared
- performance: PerformanceSummary; default: not declared
- performance.alpha?: number | null; default: not declared — Annualized Jensen's alpha (only when `options.benchmark` is supplied).
- performance.annualizedReturn: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when compounding overflowed (disclosed via `performance.non_finite_metric`).
- performance.annualizedVolatility: number | null; default: not declared
- performance.assumptions: { benchmarkLength?: number; periodsPerYear: number; riskFreeRate: number; }; default: not declared — The conventions actually applied — a serialized summary is self-interpreting (spec §7.4).
- performance.assumptions.benchmarkLength?: number; default: not declared — Length of the benchmark return series, present only when a benchmark was supplied.
- performance.assumptions.periodsPerYear: number; default: not declared — Annualization factor used for all annualized metrics.
- performance.assumptions.riskFreeRate: number; default: not declared — Per-period risk-free rate used for Sharpe/Sortino/alpha/Treynor (0 when unspecified).
- performance.beta?: number | null; default: not declared — Beta to the benchmark (only when `options.benchmark` is supplied).
- performance.calmar: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when the metric is undefined for this input (disclosed via warnings).
- performance.drawdown: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/performance').DrawdownResult; default: not declared
- performance.drawdown.longestDurationPeriods: number; default: not declared — Longest underwater stretch, in periods.
- performance.drawdown.maxDrawdown: number; default: not declared — Maximum drawdown as a positive fraction (0.2 = a 20% peak-to-trough decline).
- performance.drawdown.peakIndex: number; default: not declared — Index of the peak preceding the worst drawdown.
- performance.drawdown.recoveryIndex?: number; default: not declared — Index at which equity first regained the pre-drawdown peak after the worst trough (WS3.3c).
Absent when the curve never recovered by the end of the series (still underwater).
- performance.drawdown.troughIndex: number; default: not declared — Index of the trough of the worst drawdown.
- performance.expectancy: number | null; default: not declared — Mean per-period return (expectancy); `null` on an empty series or overflow (disclosed).
- performance.hitRate: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when the metric is undefined for this input (disclosed via warnings).
- performance.informationRatio?: number | null; default: not declared — Information ratio (only when `options.benchmark` is supplied).
- performance.maxDrawdown: number; default: not declared
- performance.omega: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when the metric is undefined for this input (disclosed via warnings).
- performance.periods: number; default: not declared
- performance.profitFactor: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when the metric is undefined for this input (disclosed via warnings).
- performance.sharpe: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when the metric is undefined for this input (disclosed via warnings).
- performance.sortino: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when the metric is undefined for this input (disclosed via warnings).
- performance.totalReturn: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when compounding overflowed (disclosed via `performance.non_finite_metric`).
- performance.trackingError?: number | null; default: not declared — Annualized tracking error (only when `options.benchmark` is supplied).
- performance.treynor?: number | null; default: not declared — Treynor ratio (only when `options.benchmark` is supplied).
- performance.warnings: QuantWarning[]; default: not declared — Diagnostics — e.g. `performance.suspicious_equity_input` when an equity curve looks like returns.
- returns: ReturnStatistics; default: not declared
- returns.averageLoss: number; default: not declared
- returns.averageWin: number; default: not declared
- returns.bestPeriod: number; default: not declared
- returns.expectancy: number | null; default: not declared — Mean per-bar return. `null` on an EMPTY series (no bars to average), disclosed the same way —
matches `@insiderfinance/totalfinance/performance`'s `analyze().expectancy`, which never reports a fabricated `0`.
- returns.hitRate: number | null; default: not declared — Fraction of non-zero return bars that were positive. `null` when the series has NO non-zero
bar — there is no win/loss population to take a fraction of, so the metric is undefined and is
disclosed via a `performance.undefined_metric` warning rather than reported as a `0` hit rate
(which reads as "every bar lost"). Matches `@insiderfinance/totalfinance/performance`'s `analyze().hitRate`.
- returns.profitFactor: number | null; default: not declared — Σ gains ÷ |Σ losses|. `null` when there are gains but NO losses — the ratio has no finite
value, so it is disclosed via a `performance.undefined_metric` warning, never `Infinity`
(Law 7). `0` when there are no gains either.
- returns.worstPeriod: number; default: not declared

- trades.count: number; default: not declared
- trades.totalCommission: number; default: not declared
- trades.totalSlippage: number; default: not declared
- trades.turnover: number; default: not declared

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest#Trade

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

A filled trade. `quantity` is always positive; `side` carries the direction (core `OrderSide`, B6).

```typescript
/** A filled trade. `quantity` is always positive; `side` carries the direction (core `OrderSide`, B6). */
export interface Trade {
    symbol: SymbolId;
    timestampMs: EpochMs;
    side: OrderSide;
    /** Filled quantity (> 0). */
    quantity: number;
    /** Fill price *after* slippage. */
    price: number;
    /** Commission charged on this fill. */
    commission: number;
    /** Slippage cost (signed against the trader) embedded in `price` vs the reference. */
    slippage: number;
    /**
     * Contract multiplier of the instrument traded — `1` for a share, the registered option's
     * multiplier (default 100) for an option symbol. Cash value of the fill is
     * `quantity · price · multiplier`; turnover and realized-P&L attribution apply it or a
     * 100×-multiplier option trade is reported at 1% of its true size. Every engine stamps it —
     * the share-only loops (vectorized, cross-sectional) stamp `1` by construction — so no reader
     * has to guess what an absent field meant.
     */
    multiplier: number;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- commission: number; default: not declared — Commission charged on this fill.
- multiplier: number; default: not declared — Contract multiplier of the instrument traded — `1` for a share, the registered option's
multiplier (default 100) for an option symbol. Cash value of the fill is
`quantity · price · multiplier`; turnover and realized-P&L attribution apply it or a
100×-multiplier option trade is reported at 1% of its true size. Every engine stamps it —
the share-only loops (vectorized, cross-sectional) stamp `1` by construction — so no reader
has to guess what an absent field meant.
- price: number; default: not declared — Fill price *after* slippage.
- quantity: number; default: not declared — Filled quantity (> 0).
- side: OrderSide; default: not declared
- slippage: number; default: not declared — Slippage cost (signed against the trader) embedded in `price` vs the reference.
- symbol: string; default: not declared
- timestampMs: number; default: not declared

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest#VectorizedOptions

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

```typescript
export interface VectorizedOptions {
    /** Price bars in ascending time order. */
    data: Bar[];
    /**
     * Target exposure per bar, aligned to `data`. A boolean is long (`1`) / flat (`0`); a number is a
     * target weight (fraction of equity; negative = short), clamped to `maxLeverage`.
     *
     * Accepts a warmup-aware {@link SeriesSignal} (`{ value, warmup }`, e.g. a `technicalAnalysis.*.explain(...)`
     * result) so an indicator's leading warmup NaNs are treated as flat (position 0) instead of
     * throwing. A bare `number[]`/`Float64Array` has an implicit `warmup` of 0, so any NaN in it still
     * throws (a genuine mid-series NaN is a real error, not warmup).
     */
    signal: ArrayLike<number | boolean> | SeriesSignal | EnvelopeSignal;
    /** Rebalance calendar (default `everyBar`). */
    rebalance?: RebalanceRule;
    /** Commission model (default `fees.none()`). */
    fees?: CostModel;
    /** Slippage model (default `slippage.none()`). */
    slippage?: SlippageModel;
    /** Short borrow-fee model (default `borrow.none()`). */
    borrow?: BorrowModel;
    /** Opening capital (default 1). */
    initialCapital?: number;
    /** Bars per year, for annualized metrics (default 252). */
    periodsPerYear?: number;
    /** Per-asset gross weight cap applied to the signal (default 1). */
    maxLeverage?: number;
    /** Bars between observing the signal and trading on it; ≥ 1 avoids look-ahead (default 1). */
    executionLag?: number;
    /** Annualized risk-free rate for Sharpe/Sortino (default 0). */
    riskFreeRate?: number;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- borrow?: BorrowModel; default: not declared — Short borrow-fee model (default `borrow.none()`).
- borrow.annualRate: number; default: not declared — Annualized borrow rate (decimal, e.g. `0.005` = 50 bps/yr).
- borrow.label: string; default: not declared
- data: Bar[]; default: not declared — Price bars in ascending time order.
- executionLag?: number; default: not declared — Bars between observing the signal and trading on it; ≥ 1 avoids look-ahead (default 1).
- fees?: CostModel; default: not declared — Commission model (default `fees.none()`).
- fees.commission: (input: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/costs').CommissionInput) => number; default: not declared
- fees.commission(input): import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/costs').CommissionInput; default: not declared
- fees.commission(input).price: number; default: not declared
- fees.commission(input).quantity: number; default: not declared
- fees.label: string; default: not declared
- initialCapital?: number; default: not declared — Opening capital (default 1).
- maxLeverage?: number; default: not declared — Per-asset gross weight cap applied to the signal (default 1).
- periodsPerYear?: number; default: not declared — Bars per year, for annualized metrics (default 252).
- rebalance?: RebalanceRule; default: not declared — Rebalance calendar (default `everyBar`).
- riskFreeRate?: number; default: not declared — Annualized risk-free rate for Sharpe/Sortino (default 0).
- signal: ArrayLike<number | boolean> | SeriesSignal | EnvelopeSignal; default: not declared — Target exposure per bar, aligned to `data`. A boolean is long (`1`) / flat (`0`); a number is a
target weight (fraction of equity; negative = short), clamped to `maxLeverage`.

Accepts a warmup-aware {@link SeriesSignal} (`{ value, warmup }`, e.g. a `technicalAnalysis.*.explain(...)`
result) so an indicator's leading warmup NaNs are treated as flat (position 0) instead of
throwing. A bare `number[]`/`Float64Array` has an implicit `warmup` of 0, so any NaN in it still
throws (a genuine mid-series NaN is a real error, not warmup).
- signal.diagnostics: { warmup: number; }; default: not declared
- signal.diagnostics.warmup: number; default: not declared
- signal.value: ArrayLike<number>; default: not declared — Per-bar signal values, aligned to the price bars.
- signal.warmup: number; default: not declared — Count of leading bars that may be non-finite by design (the indicator's warmup).
- slippage?: SlippageModel; default: not declared — Slippage model (default `slippage.none()`).

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest#WalkForwardOptions

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

```typescript
export interface WalkForwardOptions {
    /** Bars in ascending time order (one symbol, or a pre-sorted multi-symbol stream). */
    data: Bar[];
    /** Training window length in bars. */
    trainSize: number;
    /** Test (out-of-sample) window length in bars. */
    testSize: number;
    /** Step between successive windows (default `testSize`, i.e. non-overlapping test windows). */
    step?: number;
    /** `rolling` (sliding train window) or `anchored` (train grows from the start). Default `rolling`. */
    mode?: 'rolling' | 'anchored';
    /** Run a backtest over a window; return its out-of-sample result. */
    run: (window: WalkForwardWindow) => BacktestResult;
    /** Bars per year for the stitched performance (default 252). */
    periodsPerYear?: number;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- data: Bar[]; default: not declared — Bars in ascending time order (one symbol, or a pre-sorted multi-symbol stream).
- mode?: 'rolling' | 'anchored'; default: not declared — `rolling` (sliding train window) or `anchored` (train grows from the start). Default `rolling`.
- periodsPerYear?: number; default: not declared — Bars per year for the stitched performance (default 252).
- run: (window: WalkForwardWindow) => BacktestResult; default: not declared — Run a backtest over a window; return its out-of-sample result.
- run().return.assumptions: BacktestAssumptions; default: not declared — The modelling assumptions this run made — capital, fills, costs, calendar, margin (dx §2.5).
- run().return.diagnostics: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest').ImplementationRisk; default: not declared — Implementation-risk diagnostics: warnings + benchmark fixture version (spec §16.3).
- run().return.finalValue: number; default: not declared — Final portfolio value.
- run().return.performance: PerformanceSummary; default: not declared — Performance metrics of the equity curve (`@insiderfinance/totalfinance/performance`).
- run().return.points: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest').EquityPoint[]; default: not declared — The equity curve as an explicit `(ts, equity)` series (length = number of bars + 1). `points[0]`
is the opening capital stamped at the first bar's timestamp; see {@link EquityPoint}.
- run().return.returns: number[]; default: not declared — Per-bar simple returns of the equity curve.
- run().return.settlements?: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest').OptionSettlement[]; default: not declared — Option positions settled at expiry (exercise / assignment / worthless), if any.
- run().return.trades: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest').Trade[]; default: not declared — Every filled trade, in order.
- run().return.turnover: number; default: not declared — Sum of |traded notional| ÷ average equity — a turnover proxy.
- run(window): WalkForwardWindow; default: not declared
- run(window).test: Bar[]; default: not declared
- run(window).train: Bar[]; default: not declared
- step?: number; default: not declared — Step between successive windows (default `testSize`, i.e. non-overlapping test windows).
- testSize: number; default: not declared — Test (out-of-sample) window length in bars.
- trainSize: number; default: not declared — Training window length in bars.

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest#WalkForwardResult

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

```typescript
export interface WalkForwardResult {
    /** The per-window out-of-sample results, in order, each tagged with its train/test ranges. */
    windows: WalkForwardWindowResult[];
    /** Out-of-sample equity stitched across all test windows (starts at 1). */
    equityCurve: number[];
    /** Performance of the stitched out-of-sample curve. */
    performance: PerformanceSummary;
    /**
     * The echoed modelling assumptions, identical across windows (same engine/config) — taken from the
     * first window, so the walk-forward artifact carries the same honesty story as a single backtest
     * (WS2.8 / dx §2.5).
     */
    assumptions: BacktestAssumptions;
    /** Core diagnostics: the union of every window's warnings, deduped by code + message (WS2.8). */
    diagnostics: Diagnostics;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- assumptions: BacktestAssumptions; default: not declared — The echoed modelling assumptions, identical across windows (same engine/config) — taken from the
first window, so the walk-forward artifact carries the same honesty story as a single backtest
(WS2.8 / dx §2.5).
- assumptions.assignment?: string; default: not declared — American early exercise/assignment policy: `model` or `none` (WS7.4). Absent where inapplicable.
- assumptions.calendar: string; default: not declared — Rebalancing/trading calendar, e.g. `every-bar`, `monthly`, `signal-driven`.
- assumptions.cashSettlement: string; default: not declared — Cash settlement assumption, e.g. `immediate` (T+0).
- assumptions.conventionsVersion: string; default: not declared — Version of the library's default conventions (core `CONVENTIONS_VERSION`).
- assumptions.corporateAction: string; default: not declared — Corporate-action handling, e.g. `dividends-as-cash`, `splits-adjusted`, `none`.
- assumptions.cost: string; default: not declared — Commission model applied, e.g. `bps(1)`, `per-share(0.005)`, `none`.
- assumptions.fill: string; default: not declared — When/at what price orders fill, e.g. `next-open`, `close`, `trigger-price`.
- assumptions.initialCapital: number; default: not declared — Opening capital the run started from.
- assumptions.margin: string; default: not declared — Leverage/margin regime: `unconstrained` (no cap; unfunded fills allowed) or `maxLeverage`.
- assumptions.oco?: string; default: not declared — How an OCO group resolves a bar that touches BOTH legs. One bar cannot say which trigger came
first, and the engine's answer — the take-profit, because a bracket submits it before the
stop-loss and orders fill in submission order — is optimistic. It is disclosed here rather than
left as an undocumented mechanic (`take-profit-first-on-ambiguous-bar`). Absent for engines with
no order book (the vectorized loop).
- assumptions.slippage: string; default: not declared — Slippage model applied, e.g. `bps(2)`, `spread`, `none`.
- diagnostics: Diagnostics; default: not declared — Core diagnostics: the union of every window's warnings, deduped by code + message (WS2.8).
- diagnostics.autoReason?: string; default: not declared — When a meta-engine (e.g. `engines.auto()`) selected a delegate, this is a one-sentence,
human-readable explanation of WHY that delegate was chosen (`engine` then names the delegate).
Absent when no auto-selection took place.
- diagnostics.converged?: boolean; default: not declared — Whether an iterative procedure converged. `false` means the value is not trustworthy.
- diagnostics.decomposition?: Record<string, number>; default: not declared — Named intermediate quantities the value decomposes into — a par spread's protection leg and
risky annuity, a forward variance's near/far legs. The H-series explain paths disclose their
arithmetic here so a caller can audit the ratio, not just receive it (3B.3).
- diagnostics.engine?: string; default: not declared — Pricing/solver engine name, e.g. `black-scholes-merton`.
- diagnostics.finiteDifferenceBumps?: Record<string, number>; default: not declared — Finite-difference engines: the ACTUAL bump sizes used for FD Greeks (spec P2.3) — adaptive
near the vol/time boundaries, so the caller can see exactly what was differenced.
Keys: `spotStep`, `volatilityStep`, `timeStepYears`, `rateStep`, and — extended Greeks only —
`dividendYieldStep`. Each is the actual step differenced, in the unit of the coordinate it
bumps. (This doc named the retired `hS`/`hSig`/`hT`/`hR`/`hQ` keys for one release after the
emit sites had moved to the semantic names, so a caller following it read `undefined`.)
- diagnostics.iterations?: number; default: not declared — Iteration count for iterative methods.
- diagnostics.method?: string; default: not declared — Numerical method, e.g. `closed-form`, `brent`, `finite-difference`.
- diagnostics.selection?: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing').SelectionReport; default: not declared — The structured engine-selection report (Gate C, `@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing`): who was selected,
why, and — for automatic selection — every candidate considered with its verdict. This is the
machine-readable superset of `engine` + `autoReason` (which remain for compatibility);
`selected.name` always agrees with `engine` when both are present.
- diagnostics.selection.candidates?: readonly import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing').SelectionCandidate[]; default: not declared — Candidates an automatic selection considered; absent for explicit mode.
- diagnostics.selection.mode: 'explicit' | 'automatic'; default: not declared
- diagnostics.selection.reason: string; default: not declared — Why the selected engine answers this request.
- diagnostics.selection.selected: { name: string; version?: string; }; default: not declared
- diagnostics.selection.selected.name: string; default: not declared
- diagnostics.selection.selected.version?: string; default: not declared
- diagnostics.timingMs?: number; default: not declared — Wall-clock timing in milliseconds, when measured.
- diagnostics.warmup?: number; default: not declared — Series facades: number of leading output slots that are warmup sentinels (null/NaN) while the
computation seeds. Equals the input length when the indicator never emitted.
- diagnostics.warnings: QuantWarning[]; default: not declared — Structured warnings; always present (possibly empty).
- equityCurve: number[]; default: not declared — Out-of-sample equity stitched across all test windows (starts at 1).
- performance: PerformanceSummary; default: not declared — Performance of the stitched out-of-sample curve.
- performance.alpha?: number | null; default: not declared — Annualized Jensen's alpha (only when `options.benchmark` is supplied).
- performance.annualizedReturn: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when compounding overflowed (disclosed via `performance.non_finite_metric`).
- performance.annualizedVolatility: number | null; default: not declared
- performance.assumptions: { benchmarkLength?: number; periodsPerYear: number; riskFreeRate: number; }; default: not declared — The conventions actually applied — a serialized summary is self-interpreting (spec §7.4).
- performance.assumptions.benchmarkLength?: number; default: not declared — Length of the benchmark return series, present only when a benchmark was supplied.
- performance.assumptions.periodsPerYear: number; default: not declared — Annualization factor used for all annualized metrics.
- performance.assumptions.riskFreeRate: number; default: not declared — Per-period risk-free rate used for Sharpe/Sortino/alpha/Treynor (0 when unspecified).
- performance.beta?: number | null; default: not declared — Beta to the benchmark (only when `options.benchmark` is supplied).
- performance.calmar: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when the metric is undefined for this input (disclosed via warnings).
- performance.drawdown: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/performance').DrawdownResult; default: not declared
- performance.drawdown.longestDurationPeriods: number; default: not declared — Longest underwater stretch, in periods.
- performance.drawdown.maxDrawdown: number; default: not declared — Maximum drawdown as a positive fraction (0.2 = a 20% peak-to-trough decline).
- performance.drawdown.peakIndex: number; default: not declared — Index of the peak preceding the worst drawdown.
- performance.drawdown.recoveryIndex?: number; default: not declared — Index at which equity first regained the pre-drawdown peak after the worst trough (WS3.3c).
Absent when the curve never recovered by the end of the series (still underwater).
- performance.drawdown.troughIndex: number; default: not declared — Index of the trough of the worst drawdown.
- performance.expectancy: number | null; default: not declared — Mean per-period return (expectancy); `null` on an empty series or overflow (disclosed).
- performance.hitRate: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when the metric is undefined for this input (disclosed via warnings).
- performance.informationRatio?: number | null; default: not declared — Information ratio (only when `options.benchmark` is supplied).
- performance.maxDrawdown: number; default: not declared
- performance.omega: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when the metric is undefined for this input (disclosed via warnings).
- performance.periods: number; default: not declared
- performance.profitFactor: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when the metric is undefined for this input (disclosed via warnings).
- performance.sharpe: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when the metric is undefined for this input (disclosed via warnings).
- performance.sortino: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when the metric is undefined for this input (disclosed via warnings).
- performance.totalReturn: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when compounding overflowed (disclosed via `performance.non_finite_metric`).
- performance.trackingError?: number | null; default: not declared — Annualized tracking error (only when `options.benchmark` is supplied).
- performance.treynor?: number | null; default: not declared — Treynor ratio (only when `options.benchmark` is supplied).
- performance.warnings: QuantWarning[]; default: not declared — Diagnostics — e.g. `performance.suspicious_equity_input` when an equity curve looks like returns.
- windows: WalkForwardWindowResult[]; default: not declared — The per-window out-of-sample results, in order, each tagged with its train/test ranges.

- simulated().return.settleExpiries: (asOfTimestampMs: EpochMs, underlierMarks?: Map<SymbolId, number>) => OptionSettlement[]; default: not declared — Settle every registered option whose expiry is at or before `asOfTimestampMs`. ITM long positions are
exercised and ITM shorts assigned (physical: the underlier position is adjusted at the strike;
cash: the intrinsic is paid/received); OTM positions expire worthless. Returns the new settlements.
The underlier settlement price comes from `underlierMarks` or the broker's last seen mark.

expiry — every European-style golden is byte-identical. `'model'` options in to modeling early
assignment of American short options at ex-dividend dates (short calls) and deep-ITM thresholds
(short puts), plus manual `exerciseOption`/`context.exercise` for American longs.

- simulated(config).riskFreeRate?: number; default: not declared — Continuously-compounded risk-free rate (decimal, default `0`) used ONLY for the short-put
early-assignment carry economics — early put exercise is driven by the interest earned on the
strike over the option's remaining life. With rate `0` there is no carry incentive, so a short
put is never assigned early on arbitrage-free prices. Only used when `assignment: 'model'`.
- simulated(config).slippage?: SlippageModel; default: not declared

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest#createPortfolioStepper

Kind: function; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

The engine's seam (Stage 7B.1, Decision 2): the same per-instant loop `portfolioBacktest` runs,
driven from outside. `open(index)` stamps the clock, folds pre-open entitlements and external
flows, and returns a pre-execution context valued at opening or last-completed marks (the mark
source identifies carried prices). `close(index, orders)` executes the caller's orders through
the execution policy, settles close-derived derivative lifecycle, runs the margin check, records the valuation mark and the equity,
and returns the rows the step appended; `finish()` assembles the same result `portfolioBacktest`
returns over the instants closed so far. Calls must alternate `open(0)`, `close(0)`, `open(1)`, …
— an out-of-order call refuses and changes nothing; `finish()` may be called again and returns
the same result. The orders come from the caller, so the
result records `strategy: { kind: 'external', replayable: false }`; a trading environment saves
its own action trace to make an episode replayable.

```typescript
export declare function createPortfolioStepper(request: PortfolioStepperRequest): PortfolioStepper;
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- (request): PortfolioStepperRequest; default: not declared
- (request).accounting: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/portfolio').AccountingPolicy; default: not declared
- (request).calendar?: string; default: not declared — A calendar name (`'NYSE'`, `'CBOE'`, `'ALWAYS_OPEN'`): sessions and settlement days.
- (request).execution?: ExecutionPolicy; default: not declared
- (request).externalFlows?: readonly import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/portfolio').ExternalFlowRecord[]; default: not declared
- (request).instruments: Readonly<Record<string, InstrumentSpecification>>; default: not declared
- (request).marketData: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/portfolio').PortfolioMarketData; default: not declared
- (request).periodsPerYear?: number; default: not declared
- (request).seed?: number; default: not declared — Seeds only the bootstrap confidence intervals.
- (request).window?: { fromTimestampMs?: EpochMs; toTimestampMs?: EpochMs; }; default: not declared
- (request).window.fromTimestampMs?: number; default: not declared
- (request).window.toTimestampMs?: number; default: not declared
- return.close: (index: number, orders: readonly OrderIntent[]) => PortfolioStepFrame; default: not declared — The orders through the execution policy, the margin check, the valuation mark, the equity.
- return.context: () => SessionContext; default: not declared — The session context at the last closed instant — the state after its orders, margin, and mark.
- return.finish: () => PortfolioBacktestResult; default: not declared — The same result `portfolioBacktest` returns, over the instants closed so far.
- return.instants: readonly number[]; default: not declared — The decision instants, ascending — the same instants `portfolioBacktest` would step.
- return.open: (index: number) => SessionContext; default: not declared — Lifecycle facts and external flows due at the instant, then the session context.
- return.runId: string; default: not declared
- return.valuation: () => PortfolioValuationInputs; default: not declared — The ledger state, the market snapshot, the conversions, and the valued snapshot at the last closed instant.

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest#crossSectionalPurgedFolds

Kind: function; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

Purged k-fold evaluation of a cross-sectional grid: `purgedKFold` over the session index gives
every fold a held-out block, a purge gap on each side, and an embargo after it; the grid chooses
a variation on the remaining (possibly two-segment) training sessions, pooled into one curve;
the choice runs once on the held-out block. Training segments left with fewer than two sessions
after purging are dropped with a warning.

```typescript
export declare function crossSectionalPurgedFolds(request: CrossSectionalPurgedFoldsRequest): CrossSectionalOutOfSampleResult;
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- (request): CrossSectionalPurgedFoldsRequest; default: not declared
- (request).embargo?: number; default: not declared — `purgedKFold`'s embargo fraction (default 0).
- (request).folds: number; default: not declared — Folds (≥ 2, ≤ sessions ÷ 2 so every held-out span carries two sessions).
- (request).hygiene?: { confidence?: number; splits?: number; }; default: not declared
- (request).hygiene.confidence?: number; default: not declared — `researchProtocol`'s confidence in (0, 1); default 0.95.
- (request).hygiene.splits?: number; default: not declared — CSCV blocks for `probabilityOfBacktestOverfitting` (even, 4–16). Default: 16, or the largest even count the run's periods allow.
- (request).maximumVariations?: number; default: not declared — Variations the sweep may run (default 256, at most 4,096).
- (request).purgeGap?: number; default: not declared — `purgedKFold`'s purge gap in sessions on each side of a held-out span (default 0).
- (request).request: CrossSectionalBacktestRequest; default: not declared — The base request every variation is applied to; validated once, never mutated.
- (request).selectionMetric?: GridSelectionMetric; default: not declared — The metric that picks the best trial (default `'sharpe'`); ties resolve to the lower index.
- (request).variations: readonly import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest').GridVariation[]; default: not declared — The axes; the cartesian product is run with the last axis varying fastest.
- return.assumptions: OutOfSampleAssumptions; default: not declared
- return.diagnostics: OutOfSampleDiagnostics; default: not declared
- return.evaluationId: string; default: not declared — The content hash of the procedure: the grid axes, the fold plan, and every held-out run id.
- return.hygiene: OutOfSampleHygiene; default: not declared

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest#crossSectionalWalkForward

Kind: function; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

Walk a cross-sectional grid forward: on every training span the grid picks a variation by its
selection metric; that variation runs once on the following held-out span; the held-out returns
are stitched in order. Rolling (default) or anchored training spans; `step` defaults to
`testSessions` so held-out spans tile the data without overlap.

```typescript
export declare function crossSectionalWalkForward(request: CrossSectionalWalkForwardRequest): CrossSectionalOutOfSampleResult;
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- (request): CrossSectionalWalkForwardRequest; default: not declared

- (request).hygiene.splits?: number; default: not declared — CSCV blocks for `probabilityOfBacktestOverfitting` (even, 4–16). Default: 16, or the largest even count the run's periods allow.
- (request).maximumVariations?: number; default: not declared — Variations the sweep may run (default 256, at most 4,096).
- (request).mode?: 'rolling' | 'anchored'; default: not declared — `'rolling'` (default): training spans slide; `'anchored'`: every training span starts at the first session.
- (request).request: CrossSectionalBacktestRequest; default: not declared — The base request every variation is applied to; validated once, never mutated.
- (request).selectionMetric?: GridSelectionMetric; default: not declared — The metric that picks the best trial (default `'sharpe'`); ties resolve to the lower index.

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest#latchSeries

Kind: function; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

Turn discrete **entry/exit events** into a held `{0,1}` **position** series: latch to `1` on an entry
event and hold it until an exit event flips it back to `0`. This is the bridge from the cross helpers
— which fire `1` on a *single* bar — to a position {@link vectorized } can trade. Feeding a raw
{@link crossOverSeries} in as a signal is the classic silent bug: it opens the trade the bar of the
cross and *closes it the very next bar*, because every non-crossing bar is `0`. Latch the two crosses
together instead (enter on cross-over, exit on cross-under) to hold the trade between them.

Any non-zero, finite value in `entries`/`exits` counts as a fire (so `crossOverSeries`/`gtSeries`
outputs drop straight in). `NaN` in either input at bar `i` is warmup: the output is `NaN` and the
latch is left untouched, matching how the other primitives propagate an indicator's warmup. When an
entry and an exit fire on the same bar the **exit wins** (`0`), so a same-bar whipsaw never leaves a
phantom position open.

```typescript
export declare function latchSeries(entries: ArrayLike<number>, exits: ArrayLike<number>): Float64Array;
```

Example (source JSDoc):
Enter long on a 10/30 SMA golden cross, exit on the death cross, hold in between:
```ts
const entries = crossOverSeries(fast.value, slow.value);
const exits = crossUnderSeries(fast.value, slow.value);
const position = latchSeries(entries, exits); // 1 held from golden cross until death cross
const warmup = Math.max(fast.diagnostics.warmup, slow.diagnostics.warmup) + 1;
vectorized({ data: candles, signal: { value: position, warmup } });
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- (entries): ArrayLike<number>; default: not declared
- (exits): ArrayLike<number>; default: not declared

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest#returnStatistics

Kind: function; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

Return-distribution statistics from a series of per-bar returns (report-shaped, Law 2).

```typescript
export declare function returnStatistics(returns: ArrayLike<number>): ReturnStatisticsReport;
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- (returns): ArrayLike<number>; default: not declared
- return.assumptions: { [k: string]: unknown; conventionsVersion: string; }; default: not declared
- return.assumptions.conventionsVersion: string; default: not declared
- return.averageLoss: number; default: not declared
- return.averageWin: number; default: not declared
- return.bestPeriod: number; default: not declared
- return.diagnostics: { warnings: QuantWarning[]; }; default: not declared
- return.diagnostics.warnings: QuantWarning[]; default: not declared
- return.expectancy: number | null; default: not declared — Mean per-bar return. `null` on an EMPTY series (no bars to average), disclosed the same way —
matches `@insiderfinance/totalfinance/performance`'s `analyze().expectancy`, which never reports a fabricated `0`.
- return.hitRate: number | null; default: not declared — Fraction of non-zero return bars that were positive. `null` when the series has NO non-zero
bar — there is no win/loss population to take a fraction of, so the metric is undefined and is
disclosed via a `performance.undefined_metric` warning rather than reported as a `0` hit rate
(which reads as "every bar lost"). Matches `@insiderfinance/totalfinance/performance`'s `analyze().hitRate`.
- return.profitFactor: number | null; default: not declared — Σ gains ÷ |Σ losses|. `null` when there are gains but NO losses — the ratio has no finite
value, so it is disclosed via a `performance.undefined_metric` warning, never `Infinity`
(Law 7). `0` when there are no gains either.
- return.worstPeriod: number; default: not declared


Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- (options): WalkForwardOptions; default: not declared
- (options).data: Bar[]; default: not declared — Bars in ascending time order (one symbol, or a pre-sorted multi-symbol stream).
- (options).mode?: 'rolling' | 'anchored'; default: not declared — `rolling` (sliding train window) or `anchored` (train grows from the start). Default `rolling`.
- (options).periodsPerYear?: number; default: not declared — Bars per year for the stitched performance (default 252).
- (options).run: (window: WalkForwardWindow) => BacktestResult; default: not declared — Run a backtest over a window; return its out-of-sample result.
- (options).step?: number; default: not declared — Step between successive windows (default `testSize`, i.e. non-overlapping test windows).
- (options).testSize: number; default: not declared — Test (out-of-sample) window length in bars.
- (options).trainSize: number; default: not declared — Training window length in bars.
- return.assumptions: BacktestAssumptions; default: not declared — The echoed modelling assumptions, identical across windows (same engine/config) — taken from the
first window, so the walk-forward artifact carries the same honesty story as a single backtest
(WS2.8 / dx §2.5).
- return.diagnostics: Diagnostics; default: not declared — Core diagnostics: the union of every window's warnings, deduped by code + message (WS2.8).
- return.equityCurve: number[]; default: not declared — Out-of-sample equity stitched across all test windows (starts at 1).
- return.performance: PerformanceSummary; default: not declared — Performance of the stitched out-of-sample curve.
- return.windows: WalkForwardWindowResult[]; default: not declared — The per-window out-of-sample results, in order, each tagged with its train/test ranges.

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/artifacts#BacktestRunKind

Kind: type; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

The run kinds this subpath records.

```typescript
/** The run kinds this subpath records. */
export type BacktestRunKind = 'cross-sectional' | 'cross-sectional-grid' | 'options' | 'portfolio' | 'environment';
```

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/artifacts#BacktestRunKindDescriptor

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

The frozen, data-only description of one run kind.

```typescript
/** The frozen, data-only description of one run kind. */
export interface BacktestRunKindDescriptor {
    kind: BacktestRunKind;
    runVersion: number;
    /** The direct verb the run re-issues on replay. */
    operation: string;
    /** Bulk row sets of the request (dotted paths); each may be embedded or referenced by table handle. */
    inputRowSets: readonly string[];
    /** Bulk row sets of the run (dotted paths under `run.`); each may be embedded or referenced. */
    resultRowSets: readonly string[];
    /** Request fields that, when they carry a caller function, make the run non-replayable. */
    callbackFields: readonly string[];
    /** Request fields recorded by description (execution policy, cost models); replay takes them back as `models`. */
    modelFields: readonly string[];
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- callbackFields: readonly string[]; default: not declared — Request fields that, when they carry a caller function, make the run non-replayable.
- inputRowSets: readonly string[]; default: not declared — Bulk row sets of the request (dotted paths); each may be embedded or referenced by table handle.
- kind: BacktestRunKind; default: not declared
- modelFields: readonly string[]; default: not declared — Request fields recorded by description (execution policy, cost models); replay takes them back as `models`.
- operation: string; default: not declared — The direct verb the run re-issues on replay.
- resultRowSets: readonly string[]; default: not declared — Bulk row sets of the run (dotted paths under `run.`); each may be embedded or referenced.
- runVersion: number; default: not declared

```typescript
export interface BacktestRunReplay<Kind extends BacktestRunKind = BacktestRunKind> {
    kind: Kind;

}
```

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/artifacts#BacktestRunReport

Kind: type; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

The typed report every verb reads and writes — the artifact's `result`, verbatim.

```typescript
/** The typed report every verb reads and writes — the artifact's `result`, verbatim. */
export type BacktestRunReport<Kind extends BacktestRunKind = BacktestRunKind> = Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> & {
    kind: Kind;
    runVersion: number;
    /** The verb's result verbatim, with referenced result row sets replaced by their table handles. */
    run: Record<string, unknown>;
    /** The request with bulk row sets embedded or referenced, callbacks omitted, models by description. */
    inputs: Record<string, unknown>;
    /** Table references for every row set that was not embedded, keyed by label (`dataset.returns`, `run.holdings`). */
    referencedData: Record<string, TableHandle>;
    /** `contentHash` of the stored run (the projection above) — the run's identity. */
    runHash: string;
    identity: BacktestRunIdentity;
    /** The caller's hygiene block (single runs) or the grid's own verdicts (grids), verbatim. */
    hygiene: BacktestHygieneBlock | null;
    /** Reserved (Decision 8): a cooperative checkpoint/resume lands in Stage 7B without changing the format. */
    execution: {
        completed: true;
    };
    assumptions: {
        conventionsVersion: string;
        kind: Kind;
        runVersion: number;
        operation: string;
        /** `false` exactly when a caller function participated. */
        replayable: boolean;
        nonReplayableField: string | null;
        inputPolicy: 'embedded' | 'referenced';
        embeddedRowLimit: number;
        modelPolicy: string;
        projection: string;
    };
    diagnostics: {
        warnings: QuantWarning[];
        embeddedRows: number;
        referencedRows: number;
        runWarningCount: number;
    };
};
```

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/artifacts#ReadBacktestRunResult

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

```typescript
export interface ReadBacktestRunResult<Kind extends BacktestRunKind = BacktestRunKind> {
    report: BacktestRunReport<Kind>;
    artifact: AnalysisArtifact;
    migrationsApplied: AppliedMigration[];
    modelMigrationsApplied: AppliedMigration[];
    /** Labels whose referenced rows were supplied, verified by hash, and restored into `report`. */
    restoredRowSets: string[];
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- artifact: AnalysisArtifact; default: not declared
- artifact.artifactType: string; default: not declared — Dot-namespaced artifact type, e.g. `'options.chain-analysis'` — names the result schema.
- artifact.conventionsVersion: string; default: not declared — The library conventions revision the artifact was CREATED under — stamped from core's
`CONVENTIONS_VERSION` (the market snapshot's law, one law), never an echo of the result and
never caller-set. Covered by the id; validated as a non-empty string on read.
- artifact.createdFrom?: string[]; default: not declared — Parent artifact ids this one was derived from, oldest first.
- artifact.id: string; default: not declared — Content hash of the body (everything but `id` and `provenance`) — stamped at creation.

- artifact.inputs.inputsHash: string; default: not declared — Hash of everything replay needs: `{ snapshotHash, parameters }` — stamped, not caller-set,
and RECOMPUTED from the stored fields on every validation pass (create and read), so a
tampered hash or tampered inputs are refused even when the outer id was re-minted to match.
- artifact.inputs.parameters?: unknown; default: not declared — The small, JSON-safe call parameters, embedded verbatim. Reference big inputs via tables.
- artifact.inputs.snapshotHash?: string; default: not declared — `marketSnapshotContentHash(...)` of the snapshot the analysis read, when one was used.

- artifact.producedBy.operation: string; default: not declared — The public operation name, e.g. `'analyzeChain'` or `'options.blackScholes.explain'`.

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/artifacts#backtestRunArtifact

Kind: function; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

Describe a run and save it as an identified, immutable artifact.

```typescript
export declare function backtestRunArtifact<Kind extends BacktestRunKind>(input: BacktestRunArtifactInput<Kind>): AnalysisArtifact;
```

Example (source JSDoc):
```ts
const run = crossSectionalBacktest(request);
const artifact = backtestRunArtifact({
  kind: 'cross-sectional',
  run,
  input: request,
  referenceRowSets: ['dataset.returns', 'run.ledger.events'],
});
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- (input): BacktestRunArtifactInput<Kind>; default: not declared
- (input).createdFrom?: string[]; default: not declared
- (input).hygiene?: BacktestHygieneBlock; default: not declared — Verbatim `@insiderfinance/totalfinance/risk` verdicts for a single run; a grid carries its own and refuses this.
- (input).input: InputOf<Kind>; default: not declared — The request as it was called — rows included; callbacks recorded and not stored; models recorded by description.
- (input).kind: Kind; default: not declared
- (input).libraryVersion?: string; default: not declared
- (input).limits?: BacktestRunArtifactLimits; default: not declared
- (input).locators?: Record<string, string>; default: not declared — Storage locators to stamp on the minted handles, keyed by row-set label.
- (input).provenance?: Provenance; default: not declared
- (input).referenceRowSets?: readonly string[]; default: not declared — Row-set labels (`dataset.returns`, `run.holdings`, `run.ledger.events`) to store by `TableHandle` instead of embedding.
- (input).run: RunOf<Kind>; default: not declared — The verb's result, verbatim.
- (input).snapshotHash?: string; default: not declared
- return.artifactType: string; default: not declared — Dot-namespaced artifact type, e.g. `'options.chain-analysis'` — names the result schema.
- return.conventionsVersion: string; default: not declared — The library conventions revision the artifact was CREATED under — stamped from core's
`CONVENTIONS_VERSION` (the market snapshot's law, one law), never an echo of the result and
never caller-set. Covered by the id; validated as a non-empty string on read.
- return.createdFrom?: string[]; default: not declared — Parent artifact ids this one was derived from, oldest first.
- return.id: string; default: not declared — Content hash of the body (everything but `id` and `provenance`) — stamped at creation.
- return.inputs: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/artifacts').ArtifactInputs; default: not declared
- return.kind: 'totalfinance.analysis-artifact'; default: not declared
- return.producedBy: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/artifacts').ArtifactProducedBy; default: not declared

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/costs#SlippageFillInput

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

A slippage model: the effective fill price, worsened against the trader from a reference price.
`quantity` is the INTENDED order size (both engines pass the real size, estimated at the reference
price for notional orders). A notional order is re-quantized once at the slipped price — a single
iteration — so a size-dependent impact model is evaluated at the intended size, not at qty = 1.

```typescript
/**
 * A slippage model: the effective fill price, worsened against the trader from a reference price.
 * `quantity` is the INTENDED order size (both engines pass the real size, estimated at the reference
 * price for notional orders). A notional order is re-quantized once at the slipped price — a single
 * iteration — so a size-dependent impact model is evaluated at the intended size, not at qty = 1.
 */
export interface SlippageFillInput {
    referencePrice: number;
    side: OrderSide;
    quantity: number;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- quantity: number; default: not declared
- referencePrice: number; default: not declared
- side: OrderSide; default: not declared

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- autoReason?: string; default: not declared — When a meta-engine (e.g. `engines.auto()`) selected a delegate, this is a one-sentence,
human-readable explanation of WHY that delegate was chosen (`engine` then names the delegate).
Absent when no auto-selection took place.
- converged?: boolean; default: not declared — Whether an iterative procedure converged. `false` means the value is not trustworthy.
- decomposition?: Record<string, number>; default: not declared — Named intermediate quantities the value decomposes into — a par spread's protection leg and
risky annuity, a forward variance's near/far legs. The H-series explain paths disclose their
arithmetic here so a caller can audit the ratio, not just receive it (3B.3).
- degenerateTrialCount: number; default: not declared
- engine?: string; default: not declared — Pricing/solver engine name, e.g. `black-scholes-merton`.
- finiteDifferenceBumps?: Record<string, number>; default: not declared — Finite-difference engines: the ACTUAL bump sizes used for FD Greeks (spec P2.3) — adaptive
near the vol/time boundaries, so the caller can see exactly what was differenced.
Keys: `spotStep`, `volatilityStep`, `timeStepYears`, `rateStep`, and — extended Greeks only —
`dividendYieldStep`. Each is the actual step differenced, in the unit of the coordinate it
bumps. (This doc named the retired `hS`/`hSig`/`hT`/`hR`/`hQ` keys for one release after the
emit sites had moved to the semantic names, so a caller following it read `undefined`.)
- iterations?: number; default: not declared — Iteration count for iterative methods.
- method?: string; default: not declared — Numerical method, e.g. `closed-form`, `brent`, `finite-difference`.
- selection?: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing').SelectionReport; default: not declared — The structured engine-selection report (Gate C, `@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing`): who was selected,
why, and — for automatic selection — every candidate considered with its verdict. This is the
machine-readable superset of `engine` + `autoReason` (which remain for compatibility);
`selected.name` always agrees with `engine` when both are present.
- selection.candidates?: readonly import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing').SelectionCandidate[]; default: not declared — Candidates an automatic selection considered; absent for explicit mode.
- selection.mode: 'explicit' | 'automatic'; default: not declared

computation seeds. Equals the input length when the indicator never emitted.
- warnings: QuantWarning[]; default: not declared — Structured warnings; always present (possibly empty).

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/cross-sectional#GridHygiene

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

```typescript
export interface GridHygiene {
    /** The trial Sharpes in variation order — the pool `researchProtocol` deflates against. */
    trialSharpes: number[];
    /** `researchProtocol` over the best trial's returns with the pool; `null` when the best trial is degenerate. */
    researchProtocol: ResearchVerdict | null;
    /** `probabilityOfBacktestOverfitting` over the periods × variations return matrix; `null` when fewer than two variations or too few periods. */
    backtestOverfitting: BacktestOverfittingProbabilityResult | null;
    /** `deflatedSharpeRatio` for the best trial against the pool; `null` when the best trial is degenerate. */
    deflatedSharpe: DeflatedSharpeResult | null;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- backtestOverfitting: BacktestOverfittingProbabilityResult | null; default: not declared — `probabilityOfBacktestOverfitting` over the periods × variations return matrix; `null` when fewer than two variations or too few periods.
- backtestOverfitting.assumptions: { [k: string]: unknown; conventionsVersion: string; }; default: not declared — Applied conventions, echoed (Law 2 report grammar).
- backtestOverfitting.assumptions.conventionsVersion: string; default: not declared
- backtestOverfitting.backtestOverfittingProbability: number; default: not declared — Probability of backtest overfitting: the fraction of the `C(S, S/2)` symmetric train/test splits on
which the in-sample-best configuration ranks **below the out-of-sample median** (logit `λ < 0`). Near
`0.5` for noise (selection is worthless out of sample), near `0` for a genuinely persistent edge.
- backtestOverfitting.combinations: number; default: not declared — Number of symmetric train/test splits evaluated: `C(S, S/2)`.
- backtestOverfitting.diagnostics: { warnings: QuantWarning[]; }; default: not declared — Structured warnings; always present (possibly empty).
- backtestOverfitting.diagnostics.warnings: QuantWarning[]; default: not declared
- backtestOverfitting.medianLogit: number; default: not declared — Median logit `λ = ln(r̄/(1−r̄))` across the splits (`r̄` = OOS relative rank of the IS-best); `< 0` ⇒ overfit-leaning.
- backtestOverfitting.observations: number; default: not declared — Observations (rows) used after trimming to a multiple of `S`.
- backtestOverfitting.splits: number; default: not declared — Blocks `S` actually used.
- backtestOverfitting.trials: number; default: not declared — Number of strategy configurations (columns) `N`.
- deflatedSharpe: DeflatedSharpeResult | null; default: not declared — `deflatedSharpeRatio` for the best trial against the pool; `null` when the best trial is degenerate.
- deflatedSharpe.assumptions: { [k: string]: unknown; conventionsVersion: string; }; default: not declared — Applied conventions, echoed (Law 2 report grammar).
- deflatedSharpe.assumptions.conventionsVersion: string; default: not declared
- deflatedSharpe.deflatedSharpe: number | null; default: not declared — `null` when the statistics carry no Sharpe (a zero-variance series).
- deflatedSharpe.diagnostics: { warnings: QuantWarning[]; }; default: not declared — Structured warnings; always present (possibly empty).
- deflatedSharpe.diagnostics.warnings: QuantWarning[]; default: not declared
- deflatedSharpe.expectedMaxSharpe: number; default: not declared — Expected maximum Sharpe across `trialCount` under the null — the deflation benchmark `SR₀`.
- deflatedSharpe.probabilisticSharpe: number | null; default: not declared — The un-deflated PSR (benchmark 0), for comparison.
- deflatedSharpe.trialCount: number; default: not declared
- researchProtocol: ResearchVerdict | null; default: not declared — `researchProtocol` over the best trial's returns with the pool; `null` when the best trial is degenerate.
- researchProtocol.assumptions: { confidence: number; conventionsVersion: string; periodsPerYear: number; }; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.assumptions.confidence: number; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.assumptions.conventionsVersion: string; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.assumptions.periodsPerYear: number; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.deflatedSharpe: number | null; default: not declared — Probability the true Sharpe beats the selection-adjusted benchmark SR₀; `null` with `inSample.sharpe`.
- researchProtocol.diagnostics: Diagnostics; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.autoReason?: string; default: not declared — When a meta-engine (e.g. `engines.auto()`) selected a delegate, this is a one-sentence,
human-readable explanation of WHY that delegate was chosen (`engine` then names the delegate).
Absent when no auto-selection took place.
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.converged?: boolean; default: not declared — Whether an iterative procedure converged. `false` means the value is not trustworthy.
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.decomposition?: Record<string, number>; default: not declared — Named intermediate quantities the value decomposes into — a par spread's protection leg and
risky annuity, a forward variance's near/far legs. The H-series explain paths disclose their
arithmetic here so a caller can audit the ratio, not just receive it (3B.3).
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.engine?: string; default: not declared — Pricing/solver engine name, e.g. `black-scholes-merton`.
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.finiteDifferenceBumps?: Record<string, number>; default: not declared — Finite-difference engines: the ACTUAL bump sizes used for FD Greeks (spec P2.3) — adaptive
near the vol/time boundaries, so the caller can see exactly what was differenced.
Keys: `spotStep`, `volatilityStep`, `timeStepYears`, `rateStep`, and — extended Greeks only —
`dividendYieldStep`. Each is the actual step differenced, in the unit of the coordinate it
bumps. (This doc named the retired `hS`/`hSig`/`hT`/`hR`/`hQ` keys for one release after the
emit sites had moved to the semantic names, so a caller following it read `undefined`.)
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.iterations?: number; default: not declared — Iteration count for iterative methods.
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.method?: string; default: not declared — Numerical method, e.g. `closed-form`, `brent`, `finite-difference`.
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.selection?: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing').SelectionReport; default: not declared — The structured engine-selection report (Gate C, `@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing`): who was selected,
why, and — for automatic selection — every candidate considered with its verdict. This is the
machine-readable superset of `engine` + `autoReason` (which remain for compatibility);
`selected.name` always agrees with `engine` when both are present.
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.selection.candidates?: readonly import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing').SelectionCandidate[]; default: not declared — Candidates an automatic selection considered; absent for explicit mode.
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.selection.mode: 'explicit' | 'automatic'; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.selection.reason: string; default: not declared — Why the selected engine answers this request.
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.selection.selected: { name: string; version?: string; }; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.selection.selected.name: string; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.selection.selected.version?: string; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.timingMs?: number; default: not declared — Wall-clock timing in milliseconds, when measured.
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.warmup?: number; default: not declared — Series facades: number of leading output slots that are warmup sentinels (null/NaN) while the
computation seeds. Equals the input length when the indicator never emitted.
- researchProtocol.diagnostics.warnings: QuantWarning[]; default: not declared — Structured warnings; always present (possibly empty).
- researchProtocol.expectedMaxSharpe: number; default: not declared — SR₀ — the expected-max Sharpe of `trialCount` under the null (0 for a single hypothesis).
- researchProtocol.inSample: { annualizedSharpe: number | null; observations: number; sharpe: number | null; }; default: not declared — Sharpe figures are `null` (C hygiene) when the returns have zero variance; the verdict is then `inconclusive`.
- researchProtocol.inSample.annualizedSharpe: number | null; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.inSample.observations: number; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.inSample.sharpe: number | null; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.minTrackRecordLength: number; default: not declared — Observations needed for `deflatedSharpe ≥ confidence` (`Infinity` when SR ≤ SR₀).
- researchProtocol.outOfSample?: { annualizedSharpe: number | null; degradation: number | null; sharpe: number | null; }; default: not declared — Present when out-of-sample returns are given; `null` figures when either series has zero variance.
- researchProtocol.outOfSample.annualizedSharpe: number | null; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.outOfSample.degradation: number | null; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.outOfSample.sharpe: number | null; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.probabilisticSharpe: number | null; default: not declared — Un-deflated PSR (benchmark 0), for comparison; `null` with `inSample.sharpe`.
- researchProtocol.rationale: string; default: not declared — Prose an agent relays.
- researchProtocol.trialCount: number; default: not declared
- researchProtocol.verdict: 'significant' | 'inconclusive' | 'likely-overfit'; default: not declared
- trialSharpes: number[]; default: not declared — The trial Sharpes in variation order — the pool `researchProtocol` deflates against.

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/environment#RewardComposition

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

The declared reward composition — weights on the components below; absent components are reported with weight 0.

```typescript
/** The declared reward composition — weights on the components below; absent components are reported with weight 0. */
export interface RewardComposition {
    /** On the step's net return, Δ NAV ÷ NAV before the step. */
    pnl?: number;
    /** On the INCREASE in drawdown from the episode's running peak (a recovery pays 0). */
    drawdown?: number;
    /** On traded notional ÷ NAV before the step. */
    turnover?: number;
    /** On commissions, fees, and slippage ÷ NAV before the step. */
    cost?: number;
    /** On the largest absolute position weight after the step. */
    concentration?: number;
    /** On gross exposure ÷ NAV after the step. */
    leverage?: number;
    /** On the count of limit breaches and disallowed orders in the step. */
    riskViolation?: number;
    /** On the step return minus the named instrument's bar return over the step. */
    benchmark?: {
        weight: number;
        instrumentId: string;
    };
    /** Extra named terms (weight 1 each); a callback, so the definition is not replayable. */
    goal?: (frame: RewardFrame) => Record<string, number>;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- benchmark?: { instrumentId: string; weight: number; }; default: not declared — On the step return minus the named instrument's bar return over the step.
- benchmark.instrumentId: string; default: not declared
- benchmark.weight: number; default: not declared
- concentration?: number; default: not declared — On the largest absolute position weight after the step.
- cost?: number; default: not declared — On commissions, fees, and slippage ÷ NAV before the step.
- drawdown?: number; default: not declared — On the INCREASE in drawdown from the episode's running peak (a recovery pays 0).
- goal?: (frame: RewardFrame) => Record<string, number>; default: not declared — Extra named terms (weight 1 each); a callback, so the definition is not replayable.
- goal(frame): RewardFrame; default: not declared
- goal(frame).asOf: number; default: not declared
- goal(frame).benchmarkReturn: number | null; default: not declared — The benchmark instrument's bar-close return over the step, or null without two closes.
- goal(frame).costs: number; default: not declared — Σ commission + fees + slippage adjustment of the step's fills, base currency.
- goal(frame).drawdownAfter: number; default: not declared
- goal(frame).drawdownBefore: number; default: not declared — 1 − NAV ÷ running peak, before and after the step.
- goal(frame).fills: readonly NormalizedFill[]; default: not declared
- goal(frame).grossExposure: number; default: not declared
- goal(frame).largestPositionWeight: number; default: not declared
- goal(frame).netAssetValueAfter: number; default: not declared
- goal(frame).netAssetValueBefore: number; default: not declared

- (label): string; default: not declared
- (value): unknown; default: not declared
- return.drawdown?: boolean; default: not declared — 1 − close ÷ running peak close, per instrument.

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/environment#requireRewardComposition

Kind: function; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

The reward composition: finite weights, a benchmark with a weight and an instrument, an optional goal callback (Decision 7).

```typescript
export declare function requireRewardComposition(functionName: string, label: string, value: unknown): RewardComposition;
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- (functionName): string; default: not declared
- (label): string; default: not declared
- (value): unknown; default: not declared
- return.benchmark?: { instrumentId: string; weight: number; }; default: not declared — On the step return minus the named instrument's bar return over the step.
- return.benchmark.instrumentId: string; default: not declared
- return.benchmark.weight: number; default: not declared
- return.concentration?: number; default: not declared — On the largest absolute position weight after the step.
- return.cost?: number; default: not declared — On commissions, fees, and slippage ÷ NAV before the step.
- return.drawdown?: number; default: not declared — On the INCREASE in drawdown from the episode's running peak (a recovery pays 0).
- return.goal?: (frame: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/environment').RewardFrame) => Record<string, number>; default: not declared — Extra named terms (weight 1 each); a callback, so the definition is not replayable.
- return.leverage?: number; default: not declared — On gross exposure ÷ NAV after the step.
- return.pnl?: number; default: not declared — On the step's net return, Δ NAV ÷ NAV before the step.
- return.riskViolation?: number; default: not declared — On the count of limit breaches and disallowed orders in the step.
- return.turnover?: number; default: not declared — On traded notional ÷ NAV before the step.

```typescript
export interface ExecutionPolicyDescription {
    label: string;

        halts: number;
        priceLimits: number;
        auction: 'ignore' | 'open-close-only' | null;
    };
    partialFills: PartialFillPolicy;

        default: TimeInForce;
        expireAtSessionClose: boolean;
    };
    margin: MarginPolicy;
}
```

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/execution#barTriggerPrice

Kind: function; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

Where a bar fills an order, or `null` when the bar never touched it. Market and market-on-open
fill at the open; market-on-close at the close; a limit fills at the open when the open is
already through it, else at the limit when the range reached it; a stop triggers on the range
and fills at the worse of the open and the stop (a gap through the stop fills at the open); a
stop-limit becomes a limit at the stop instant, so its effective open is the stop unless the bar
gapped through it.

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/execution#normalizedFillsFromBacktest

Kind: function; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

B6 — the bridge from a backtest's trades to the ledger's fills: one `NormalizedFill` per trade,
keyed by `instrumentId = symbol`, the contract multiplier the engine stamped, commission and
commission as a cash cost. Slippage is already in trade.price; trade.slippage is attribution,

through `portfolioEventsFromFill` exactly like a paper broker's.
