- (input).instruments?: Readonly<Record<string, { contract?: NormalizedFill['contract']; settlementStyle?: NormalizedFill['settlementStyle']; settleTimestampMs?: EpochMs; }>>; default: not declared — Instrument terms by symbol (an option's contract, its settlement style) for fills that need them.
- (input).sourceId: string; default: not declared — Fill ids default to `<sourceId>:fill:<n>`; the source names the run.
- (input).trades: readonly Trade[]; default: not declared — The run's trades (`result.trades`), in order.

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/execution#orderTouchSequence

Kind: function; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

Resolve the fill sequence of the orders a bar touched. Touches on one side of the open are
never ambiguous (nearer the open fills first). Touches on both sides are: `deterministic-path`
walks open → low → high → close on an up bar (close ≥ open) and open → high → low → close on a
down bar; `optimistic` walks the side holding a favorable touch first (and the deterministic
path when both sides do); `pessimistic` the reverse; `reject` refuses with
`backtest.ambiguous_intrabar` naming the orders.

```typescript
export declare function orderTouchSequence(input: OrderTouchSequenceInput): OrderTouchSequenceResult;
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- (input): OrderTouchSequenceInput; default: not declared
- (input).bar: { open: number; high: number; low: number; close: number; }; default: not declared
- (input).bar.close: number; default: not declared
- (input).bar.high: number; default: not declared
- (input).bar.low: number; default: not declared
- (input).bar.open: number; default: not declared
- (input).policy: AmbiguityPolicy; default: not declared
- (input).touches: readonly IntrabarTouch[]; default: not declared
- return.ambiguous: boolean; default: not declared — Whether the bar alone could not decide the sequence (the policy did).
- return.path: IntrabarPath; default: not declared — The path the sequence assumes; `unambiguous` when every touch lay on one side of the open.
- return.policy: AmbiguityPolicy; default: not declared
- return.sequence: string[]; default: not declared — Order ids in fill sequence.

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/options#EntryRule

Kind: type; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

The entry rule — a discriminated union over `structure`, mirroring `strategyFromChain`'s option
grammar so the declarative form maps 1:1 onto the library. The `build` variant is the full escape
hatch: return a `Position` (or `null` to skip) built however you like from the snapshot.

```typescript
/**
 * The entry rule — a discriminated union over `structure`, mirroring `strategyFromChain`'s option
 * grammar so the declarative form maps 1:1 onto the library. The `build` variant is the full escape
 * hatch: return a `Position` (or `null` to skip) built however you like from the snapshot.
 */
export type EntryRule = (EntryCommon & {
    structure: 'ironCondor';
    select: {
        shortDelta: number;
        wingWidth: number;
    };
}) | (EntryCommon & {
    structure: 'bullCallSpread' | 'bearCallSpread' | 'bullPutSpread' | 'bearPutSpread';
    select: {
        shortDelta: number;
        width: number;
    };
}) | (EntryCommon & {
    structure: 'strangle';
    select: {
        shortDelta: number;
    };
}) | (EntryCommon & {
    structure: 'straddle';
    select?: {
        strike?: number;
    };
}) | (EntryCommon & {
    structure: 'coveredCall';
    select: {
        shortDelta: number;
        stockPrice?: number;
    };
}) | (EntryCommon & {
    structure: 'protectivePut';
    select: {
        shortDelta: number;
        stockPrice?: number;
    };
}) | (EntryCommon & {
    structure: 'calendarCallSpread' | 'calendarPutSpread';
    select: MultiExpirySelection;
}) | (EntryCommon & {
    structure: 'diagonalCallSpread' | 'diagonalPutSpread' | 'doubleDiagonal';
    select: MultiExpirySelection;
}) | (EntryCommon & {
    build: (context: EntryContext) => Position | null;
});
```

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/options#ExitContext

```typescript
/** Context passed to exit / roll callbacks. */
export interface ExitContext {
```

- daysToExpiry: number; default: not declared — Calendar days to expiry (nearest leg for a multi-expiry structure).
- entryPremium: number; default: not declared — Signed entry premium (positive = net debit paid, negative = net credit received).
- greeks: Greeks; default: not declared
- greeks.delta: number; default: not declared
- greeks.gamma: number; default: not declared
- greeks.rho: number; default: not declared
- greeks.theta: number; default: not declared
- greeks.vega: number; default: not declared
- markToMarket: number; default: not declared — Current mark-to-market P&L of the position, in account currency.
- netDelta: number; default: not declared — Aggregate share-equivalent delta of the position.
- pnlFraction: number; default: not declared — `mtm / |entryPremium|` — the fraction of the entry premium captured (+) or lost (−).
- position: Position; default: not declared
- position.assumptions: () => import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').PositionAssumptions; default: not declared — Position-construction assumptions (design law #3): whether the entry premiums were supplied by
the caller (`'user'`) or model-priced from a market (`'model'`), plus the contract multiplier.
- position.assumptions().return.constructedAs?: string; default: not declared — The named builder that constructed this position (provenance — see `classifyStrategy`).
- position.assumptions().return.multiplier: number; default: not declared — Contract multiplier applied to option legs.
- position.assumptions().return.premiumSource: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').PremiumSource; default: not declared — `'user'` when every entry premium was supplied; `'model'` when any was priced from `market`.
- position.assumptions().return.premiumVolatilitySource?: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').PremiumVolatilitySource; default: not declared — When premiums were modeled, which volatility priced them: each leg's own `impliedVolatility`
(`'leg'`), the position-level `market.volatility` (`'position'`), or both across legs
(`'mixed'`) — the same source `value()` marks with, so a chain-fed position opens flat.
- position.chartData: (options?: { prices?: number[] | import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').PriceRange; include?: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').ChartInclude; market?: Partial<Omit<import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').MarkToMarketInput, 'spot'>>; }) => Array<{ underlyingPrice: number; expirationPnl?: number; currentPnl?: number; delta?: number; theta?: number; }>; default: not declared — Chart-ready output (spec §12.5). Current P&L / live Greeks need a market: per-call fields
merge over the construction market (R5), so a model-premium position charts with no `market`.
- position.chartData(options)?: { prices?: number[] | import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').PriceRange; include?: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').ChartInclude; market?: Partial<Omit<import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').MarkToMarketInput, 'spot'>>; }; default: not declared
- position.chartData(options).include?: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').ChartInclude; default: not declared
- position.chartData(options).market?: Partial<Omit<import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').MarkToMarketInput, 'spot'>>; default: not declared
- position.chartData(options).market.asOf?: string | number; default: not declared — Snapshot time. Epoch ms, or an ISO date/datetime string parsed at the boundary.
- position.chartData(options).market.dividendYield?: number; default: not declared
- position.chartData(options).market.expiry?: string; default: not declared
- position.chartData(options).market.legVolatilities?: readonly (number | undefined)[]; default: not declared — Per-leg volatility OVERRIDES for this call (Preview P1), aligned to `position.legs`: leg `i`
prices at `legVolatilities[i]` when it is a number, else at its own `impliedVolatility`, else at
the position-level `volatility` (`volatilityShock` still adds on top). This is how a mark from
CURRENT contract quotes reaches a position whose legs were built with entry volatilities — the
position stays immutable, the call states the market. `assumptions.volatilitySource` reports
`'perCall'` when any override applied.
- position.chartData(options).market.riskFreeRate?: number; default: not declared
- position.chartData(options).market.volatility?: number; default: not declared — Position-level implied volatility. OPTIONAL: a position whose every option leg carries its own
`iv` prices entirely per-leg and needs no position vol. It is required (and validated positive)
only when at least one un-expired option leg has no per-leg `iv`; omitting it then throws.
- position.chartData(options).market.volatilityShock?: number; default: not declared — Additive volatility shock (decimal) applied to EVERY effective leg volatility — the per-leg
`impliedVolatility` when a leg carries one, and the position-level `volatility` otherwise. This
is what makes a volatility scenario reach per-leg-IV legs; without it, shocking only
`volatility` is a silent no-op for legs that fix their own implied volatility.
- position.chartData(options).prices?: number[] | import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').PriceRange; default: not declared
- position.chartData(options).prices.from: number; default: not declared
- position.chartData(options).prices.steps: number; default: not declared
- position.chartData(options).prices.to: number; default: not declared
- position.constructedAs?: string; default: not declared — PROVENANCE, not identity (dx §4.5): the named builder that constructed this position, absent
for raw `strategy(legs)`. Because positions are immutable this can never go stale — but a
rebuilt-after-tweak position has no name. For "what is this NOW?" use `classifyStrategy`.
- position.legs: readonly Readonly<Leg>[]; default: not declared — The resolved legs — a frozen snapshot (deep-copied at construction, `Object.freeze`d per leg
and as an array). A Position is immutable by design: to tweak a strategy, edit your own leg
list and rebuild with `strategy(editedLegs, config)` — every downstream calculation is generic
over the legs, so the rebuilt position needs no named builder. Mutating this array throws
instead of silently diverging from `assumptions()`/cached results.
- position.market?: Readonly<import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').PremiumMarket>; default: not declared — The market this position was built with, if any — a frozen copy (R5), so mutating the caller's
market object later never silently retargets the position. `probability()`, `value()`,
`scenarioTable()`, and `chartData()` default to it; per-call fields merge over it.
- position.market.asOf: string | number; default: not declared — Entry time (epoch ms or ISO). Each leg's entry `t = yearFraction(asOf, leg.expiry ?? market.expiry)`.
- position.market.dividendYield?: number; default: not declared
- position.market.expiry?: string; default: not declared — Default expiry for legs without their own `expiry` (single-expiry structures).
- position.market.riskFreeRate: number; default: not declared
- position.market.spot: number; default: not declared
- position.market.volatility: number; default: not declared — Entry implied volatility (annualized decimal) for unpriced legs that carry no `impliedVolatility`
of their own — a leg's own volatility always wins, exactly as it does when `value()` marks it.
- position.metrics: () => import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').PayoffMetrics; default: not declared — Net debit/credit, max profit/loss, and breakevens. The expiration payoff is piecewise-linear, so
these are computed ANALYTICALLY from the kink set (every option strike plus every stock entry
price) and the tail slopes — never by sampling a coarse grid, which missed breakevens beyond the
last strike (e.g. a lone long stock, or a deep-ITM option) and ignored stock entry prices.
- position.metrics().return.bounded: { profit: boolean; loss: boolean; }; default: not declared — Whether each tail is bounded. An unbounded side is `null` above, never `Infinity` (B3): a
naked short call has `bounded.loss === false`, a long call `bounded.profit === false`.
- position.metrics().return.bounded.loss: boolean; default: not declared
- position.metrics().return.bounded.profit: boolean; default: not declared
- position.metrics().return.breakevens: number[]; default: not declared — Underlying prices at which expiration P&L is zero.
- position.metrics().return.maxLoss: number | null; default: not declared — Maximum loss at expiration as a negative number, or `null` when unbounded (`bounded.loss`).
- position.metrics().return.maxProfit: number | null; default: not declared — Maximum profit at expiration, or `null` when the profit is unbounded (`bounded.profit`).
- position.metrics().return.netCredit: number; default: not declared — Net credit received (the negation of `netDebit`).
- position.metrics().return.netDebit: number; default: not declared — Net cash to enter: positive = debit paid, negative = credit received.
- position.monteCarloProbability: (overrides: Partial<import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').ProbabilityMonteCarloInput> & { seed: number; }) => import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').ProbabilityMonteCarloMetrics; default: not declared — Monte-Carlo probability metrics (spec §12.6): the simulated analogue of {@link probability}, for
cross-validation and path-dependent reads. Terminal lognormal paths give the probability of profit
and expected P&L (with a standard error); the probability of touching each breakeven is estimated
with the Brownian-bridge continuous-monitoring correction. Seeded and deterministic.
- position.monteCarloProbability().return.assumptions: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core').Assumptions<{ marketSource: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').MarketSource; probabilityModel: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').ProbabilityModel; }>; default: not declared — Applied conventions, plus where the market fields came from — construction market, call site,

Brownian-bridge continuous-monitoring correction (discrete sampling alone would under-count).
- position.monteCarloProbability().return.seed: number; default: not declared — The PRNG seed, echoed for reproducibility (stochastic-provenance rule, cf. `MonteCarloStatistics.seed`).
- position.monteCarloProbability(overrides): Partial<import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').ProbabilityMonteCarloInput> & { seed: number; }; default: not declared

- position.monteCarloProbability(overrides).dividendYield?: number; default: not declared
- position.monteCarloProbability(overrides).expectedReturn?: number; default: not declared — Annualized expected return, the drift of the `realWorld` measure.

**REQUIRED when `measure: 'realWorld'`, and rejected otherwise.** It used to default to
`riskFreeRate`, so `measure: 'realWorld'` with no expected return silently returned the
risk-neutral probabilities while `assumptions.probabilityModel.measure` still reported
`'realWorld'` — a result whose own echoed assumptions contradicted the number it carried.
Choosing the real-world measure IS choosing a drift, so the drift must be stated.
- position.monteCarloProbability(overrides).expiry?: string; default: not declared
- position.monteCarloProbability(overrides).localVolatility?: (level: number, timeToExpiryYears: number) => number; default: not declared — Optional Dupire local-volatility function `σ_loc(level, t)` (e.g. from
`@insiderfinance/totalfinance/volatility`'s `surfaceLocalVolatility` or `@insiderfinance/totalfinance/options`'s `dupireLocalVolatility`). When provided, the
simulation steps under local vol instead of a single lognormal σ, so probability-of-profit,
expected P&L, and probability-of-touch all reflect the volatility smile/skew — the smile-aware
multi-leg read. The function is evaluated at the price and time reached at each step.

- position.whatIfCube: (options?: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').WhatIfCubeOptions) => import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/strategy').WhatIfCubeResult; default: not declared — A what-if **cube**: the position marked over the full spot × vol-shock × days-forward grid, plus

per-leg volatilities behave identically. The optimal-exit surface is a CONDITIONAL what-if ("if the
underlying is here with this vol shock, which day marks best?"), not a path-dependent stopping rule.

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/options#ExitRule

```typescript
/**
 * When to close a position. Declarative triggers OR-combine with the `when` callback; the first to
 * fire closes the trade (its name is recorded as the exit reason).
```

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/options#GreekAttribution

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

Strategy-level greek P&L attribution — the per-trade `TradePnlExplain`s summed across every trade.
Answers "where did the P&L come from": how much of the realized gross P&L was `delta` (direction),
`theta` (decay), `gamma` (convexity), `vega` (vol), etc., plus the `unexplained` 3rd-order-and-higher
residual. `total` is the summed **gross** (pre-cost) mark P&L; the net P&L is `total −
options.totalCosts`. Because the backtester marks at constant entry IV with a fixed rate, `delta`/
`gamma`/`theta` carry most strategies and `vega`/`rho` are ~0 (see `TradePnlExplain`).

```typescript
/**
 * Strategy-level greek P&L attribution — the per-trade `TradePnlExplain`s summed across every trade.
 * Answers "where did the P&L come from": how much of the realized gross P&L was `delta` (direction),
 * `theta` (decay), `gamma` (convexity), `vega` (vol), etc., plus the `unexplained` 3rd-order-and-higher
 * residual. `total` is the summed **gross** (pre-cost) mark P&L; the net P&L is `total −
 * options.totalCosts`. Because the backtester marks at constant entry IV with a fixed rate, `delta`/
 * `gamma`/`theta` carry most strategies and `vega`/`rho` are ~0 (see `TradePnlExplain`).
 */
export interface GreekAttribution extends Omit<PnlExplain, 'assumptions' | 'diagnostics'> {
    /** Number of trades summed (every trade in the result, closed and open-at-end). */
    trades: number;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- charm: number; default: not declared — Second-order spot–time cross term: `charm·dS·dt` (0 unless the greeks carry `charm`).
- delta: number; default: not declared — Delta term: `Δ·dS`.
- deltaRate: number; default: not declared — Second-order spot–rate cross term: `deltaRate·dS·dr` (0 unless the greeks carry `deltaRate`).
- gamma: number; default: not declared — Gamma term: `½Γ·dS²`.
- phi: number; default: not declared — First-order dividend-carry term: `φ·dq` (0 unless the greeks carry `phi`).
- rho: number; default: not declared — Rho term: `Rho·dr`.
- rhoConvexity: number; default: not declared — Second-order rate-convexity term: `½·rhoConvexity·dr²` (0 unless the greeks carry `rhoConvexity`).
- theta: number; default: not declared — Theta term: `Θ·dt`.
- thetaConvexity: number; default: not declared — Second-order time-convexity term: `½·thetaConvexity·dt²` (0 unless the greeks carry `thetaConvexity`).
- thetaRate: number; default: not declared — Second-order time–rate cross term: `thetaRate·dt·dr` (0 unless the greeks carry `thetaRate`).
- total: number; default: not declared — The actual realized P&L.
- trades: number; default: not declared — Number of trades summed (every trade in the result, closed and open-at-end).
- unexplained: number; default: not declared — `total − Σ(terms)` — the full 2nd-order Taylor in (spot, vol, time, rate) plus the dividend carry
is now attributed, so the residual is only 3rd-order-and-higher (speed/ultima/…), any 2nd-order
greek the caller did not supply, and model/data. Grows as the greek expansion breaks.
- vanna: number; default: not declared — Second-order spot–vol cross term: `vanna·dS·dσ` (0 unless the greeks carry `vanna`).
- vega: number; default: not declared — Vega term: `Vega·dσ`.
- vera: number; default: not declared — Second-order vol–rate cross term: `vera·dσ·dr` (0 unless the greeks carry `vera`).
- veta: number; default: not declared — Second-order vol–time cross term: `veta·dσ·dt` (0 unless the greeks carry `veta`).
- vomma: number; default: not declared — Second-order vol-convexity term: `½·vomma·dσ²` (0 unless the greeks carry `vomma`).

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/options#LegAttribution

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

Per-leg realized P&L attribution for a closed (or marked-at-end) options trade.

```typescript
/** Per-leg realized P&L attribution for a closed (or marked-at-end) options trade. */
export interface LegAttribution {
    leg: Leg;
    realizedPnl: number;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- leg: Leg; default: not declared
- leg.expiry?: (string) | (undefined); default: not declared — Optional per-leg expiry (`YYYY-MM-DD` → 16:00 ET, or a full datetime). When omitted the leg uses
the position-level expiry supplied to `value()`. Set it for multi-expiry structures (calendars,
diagonals, double diagonals) so each leg is priced at its own time-to-expiry.

Never on an option row (a stock row's entry price).
- leg.quantity: number; default: not declared — Signed shares: positive = long, negative = short.
Signed contracts: positive = long, negative = short.
- leg.strike?: (number) | (undefined); default: not declared — Never on a stock row (typed so a union read narrows to `undefined`, not to a fake 0).
- realizedPnl: number; default: not declared

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/options#MarkingPolicy

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

How open option legs are marked at every snapshot (Preview P1 — `docs/specs/options-backtest.md`,
"Preview P1 amendment"). Every member is optional; the defaults are the truthful ones.

```typescript
/**
 * How open option legs are marked at every snapshot (Preview P1 — `docs/specs/options-backtest.md`,
 * "Preview P1 amendment"). Every member is optional; the defaults are the truthful ones.
 */
export interface MarkingPolicy {
    /**
     * `'current-quote'` (DEFAULT) re-marks each open leg from the exact current-snapshot contract
     * quote — its stated implied volatility, or one implied from the quote's selected price. `'entry'`
     * holds each leg's entry volatility for the whole trade (the pre-P1 behaviour, now explicit).
     */
    volatility?: 'current-quote' | 'entry';
    /**
     * What happens when the current contract cannot mark a leg under `'current-quote'`: `'refuse'`
     * (DEFAULT) throws `backtest.mark_unavailable` naming the leg, the snapshot, and the cause;
     * `'entry-volatility'` marks THAT leg at its entry volatility for THAT snapshot;
     * `'carry-last-volatility'` holds the leg's last successfully marked volatility (the mark still
     * reprices for spot and time). Both fallbacks are counted per trade and warned once per cause.
     */
    missingMark?: 'refuse' | 'entry-volatility' | 'carry-last-volatility';
    /**
     * A current quote whose `timestampMs` is older than the snapshot's `asOf` by more than this is
     * STALE and cannot mark (it falls to `missingMark`). Omitted ⇒ every quote a snapshot carries is
     * current by definition of the snapshot.
     */
    maximumQuoteAgeMs?: number;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- maximumQuoteAgeMs?: number; default: not declared — A current quote whose `timestampMs` is older than the snapshot's `asOf` by more than this is
STALE and cannot mark (it falls to `missingMark`). Omitted ⇒ every quote a snapshot carries is
current by definition of the snapshot.
- missingMark?: 'refuse' | 'entry-volatility' | 'carry-last-volatility'; default: not declared — What happens when the current contract cannot mark a leg under `'current-quote'`: `'refuse'`
(DEFAULT) throws `backtest.mark_unavailable` naming the leg, the snapshot, and the cause;
`'entry-volatility'` marks THAT leg at its entry volatility for THAT snapshot;
`'carry-last-volatility'` holds the leg's last successfully marked volatility (the mark still
reprices for spot and time). Both fallbacks are counted per trade and warned once per cause.
- volatility?: 'current-quote' | 'entry'; default: not declared — `'current-quote'` (DEFAULT) re-marks each open leg from the exact current-snapshot contract
quote — its stated implied volatility, or one implied from the quote's selected price. `'entry'`
holds each leg's entry volatility for the whole trade (the pre-P1 behaviour, now explicit).

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/options#OptionsBacktestConfig

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

```typescript
export interface OptionsBacktestConfig {
    /** Time-ordered (or unordered — the engine sorts) chain snapshots. */
    chains: Iterable<ChainSnapshot>;
    /** How open legs are marked at every snapshot (default: current quote; refuse a missing mark). */
    marking?: MarkingPolicy;
    /** Opening capital (default 100,000). */
    initialCapital?: number;
    /**
     * Continuously-compounded risk-free rate (decimal) for every mark-to-market price and the
     * assignment carry. REQUIRED: a backtest that silently priced at 4% was a financial assumption
     * nobody stated.
     */
    riskFreeRate: number;
    /** Continuous dividend yield for pricing (default 0). */
    dividendYield?: number;
    /** One rule (the shipped form); exactly one of `entry` and `rules` is given. */
    entry?: EntryRule;
    /** Several rules at once (Stage 4.6): each a member of the book, entered in order at every snapshot. */
    rules?: readonly EntryRule[];
    exit: ExitRule;
    /** Roll instead of closing flat when the rule fires. */
    roll?: RollRule;
    /** Optional delta-hedging with the underlying. */
    hedge?: DeltaHedgeRule;
    /** Commission model for option trades (default none). */
    commission?: CostModel;
    /** Slippage model for option trades (default none). */
    slippage?: SlippageModel;
    /** American early-assignment modeling (default `'none'`; `'model'` uses the deep-ITM/ex-div heuristic). */
    assignment?: 'model' | 'none';
    /** Annualization factor for the performance summary (default 252). */
    periodsPerYear?: number;
    /** The book's capacity (default: one open trade). */
    book?: BookPolicy;
    /** Pre-trade limits on the post-trade book. */
    limits?: PortfolioLimits;
    /** Combo or legged fills; partial-fill policy; the per-leg fill side. */
    fillPolicy?: FillPolicy;
    /** Refuse fills on stale quotes. */
    quoteFreshness?: QuoteFreshnessPolicy;
    /** Splits and symbol changes adjust open legs with lineage; mergers and spin-offs on an open leg refuse. */
    corporateActions?: readonly CorporateAction[];
    /** Cash dividends: dividend-risk evidence per short call, early assignment under `assignment: 'model'`. */
    dividends?: readonly DividendRecord[];
    /** The account currency of the ledger (default `'USD'`). */
    baseCurrency?: string;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- assignment?: 'none' | 'model'; default: not declared — American early-assignment modeling (default `'none'`; `'model'` uses the deep-ITM/ex-div heuristic).
- baseCurrency?: string; default: not declared — The account currency of the ledger (default `'USD'`).
- book?: BookPolicy; default: not declared — The book's capacity (default: one open trade).
- book.maximumOpenPositions?: number; default: not declared — Open trades at once (default 1 — the shipped single-position behaviour; at most 10,000).
- book.maximumPerUnderlying?: number; default: not declared — Open trades per underlying (default: no bound).
- chains: Iterable<ChainSnapshot>; default: not declared — Time-ordered (or unordered — the engine sorts) chain snapshots.
- commission?: CostModel; default: not declared — Commission model for option trades (default none).
- commission.commission: (input: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/costs').CommissionInput) => number; default: not declared
- commission.commission(input): import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/costs').CommissionInput; default: not declared
- commission.commission(input).price: number; default: not declared
- commission.commission(input).quantity: number; default: not declared
- commission.label: string; default: not declared
- corporateActions?: readonly CorporateAction[]; default: not declared — Splits and symbol changes adjust open legs with lineage; mergers and spin-offs on an open leg refuse.
- dividendYield?: number; default: not declared — Continuous dividend yield for pricing (default 0).
- dividends?: readonly DividendRecord[]; default: not declared — Cash dividends: dividend-risk evidence per short call, early assignment under `assignment: 'model'`.
- entry?: EntryRule; default: not declared — One rule (the shipped form); exactly one of `entry` and `rules` is given.
- exit: ExitRule; default: not declared
- exit.daysToExpiry?: number; default: not declared — Close at or below this many days to expiry.
- exit.profitTarget?: number; default: not declared — Close when captured P&L reaches this fraction of the entry premium (e.g. `0.5` = 50%).
- exit.stopLoss?: number; default: not declared — Close when the loss reaches this multiple of the entry premium (e.g. `2` = 200%).
- exit.when?: (context: ExitContext) => boolean; default: not declared — Arbitrary exit predicate (OR-combined with the declarative triggers).
- exit.when(context): ExitContext; default: not declared
- exit.when(context).asOf: number; default: not declared
- exit.when(context).daysToExpiry: number; default: not declared — Calendar days to expiry (nearest leg for a multi-expiry structure).
- exit.when(context).entryPremium: number; default: not declared — Signed entry premium (positive = net debit paid, negative = net credit received).
- exit.when(context).greeks: Greeks; default: not declared
- exit.when(context).markToMarket: number; default: not declared — Current mark-to-market P&L of the position, in account currency.
- exit.when(context).netDelta: number; default: not declared — Aggregate share-equivalent delta of the position.
- exit.when(context).pnlFraction: number; default: not declared — `mtm / |entryPremium|` — the fraction of the entry premium captured (+) or lost (−).
- exit.when(context).position: Position; default: not declared
- exit.when(context).snapshot: ChainSnapshot; default: not declared
- fillPolicy?: FillPolicy; default: not declared — Combo or legged fills; partial-fill policy; the per-leg fill side.
- fillPolicy.mode?: 'combo' | 'legged'; default: not declared — `'combo'` (default) fills every leg at once or rejects the entry; `'legged'` fills legs in order.
- fillPolicy.partialFill?: 'reject' | 'allow'; default: not declared — Under `'legged'`: reject a structure whose sequence stops early (default), or hold the filled legs.
- fillPolicy.price?: PriceSource; default: not declared — The per-leg fill side (default: the rule's `price`, else `'mid'`).
- hedge?: DeltaHedgeRule; default: not declared — Optional delta-hedging with the underlying.
- hedge.commission?: CostModel; default: not declared — Commission on the underlying hedge trades (defaults to the backtest's option commission).
- hedge.commission.commission: (input: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/costs').CommissionInput) => number; default: not declared
- hedge.commission.commission(input): import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/costs').CommissionInput; default: not declared
- hedge.commission.commission(input).price: number; default: not declared
- hedge.commission.commission(input).quantity: number; default: not declared
- hedge.commission.label: string; default: not declared
- hedge.deltaBand: number; default: not declared — Rehedge to flat delta when the absolute share-equivalent net delta exceeds this many shares.
- hedge.slippage?: SlippageModel; default: not declared — Slippage on the underlying hedge trades (defaults to the backtest's option slippage).
- hedge.slippage.fill: (input: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/costs').SlippageFillInput) => number; default: not declared
- hedge.slippage.fill(input): import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/costs').SlippageFillInput; default: not declared
- hedge.slippage.fill(input).quantity: number; default: not declared
- hedge.slippage.fill(input).referencePrice: number; default: not declared
- hedge.slippage.fill(input).side: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core').OrderSide; default: not declared
- hedge.slippage.label: string; default: not declared
- initialCapital?: number; default: not declared — Opening capital (default 100,000).
- limits?: PortfolioLimits; default: not declared — Pre-trade limits on the post-trade book.
- limits.maximumConcentration?: number; default: not declared — Premium at risk (Σ |entry premium|) in one underlying ≤ fraction × equity.
- limits.maximumMarginFraction?: number; default: not declared — `optionsMargin` of the whole book ≤ fraction × equity.
- limits.maximumNetDelta?: number; default: not declared — |Σ share-equivalent delta| per underlying ≤ this many shares.
- limits.maximumNetVega?: number; default: not declared — |Σ vega| per underlying (account currency per 1.00 volatility) ≤ this.
- limits.scenarioLoss?: { maximumLossFraction: number; spotShocks: readonly number[]; volatilityShocks: readonly number[]; }; default: not declared — The book's worst Taylor P&L over the shock grid (`scenarioGrid`) may not exceed fraction × equity.
- limits.scenarioLoss.maximumLossFraction: number; default: not declared
- limits.scenarioLoss.spotShocks: readonly number[]; default: not declared — Spot shocks as fractions (e.g. −0.1 for −10%).
- limits.scenarioLoss.volatilityShocks: readonly number[]; default: not declared — Absolute volatility shocks (e.g. 0.05 for +5 points).
- marking?: MarkingPolicy; default: not declared — How open legs are marked at every snapshot (default: current quote; refuse a missing mark).
- marking.maximumQuoteAgeMs?: number; default: not declared — A current quote whose `timestampMs` is older than the snapshot's `asOf` by more than this is
STALE and cannot mark (it falls to `missingMark`). Omitted ⇒ every quote a snapshot carries is
current by definition of the snapshot.
- marking.missingMark?: 'refuse' | 'entry-volatility' | 'carry-last-volatility'; default: not declared — What happens when the current contract cannot mark a leg under `'current-quote'`: `'refuse'`
(DEFAULT) throws `backtest.mark_unavailable` naming the leg, the snapshot, and the cause;
`'entry-volatility'` marks THAT leg at its entry volatility for THAT snapshot;
`'carry-last-volatility'` holds the leg's last successfully marked volatility (the mark still
reprices for spot and time). Both fallbacks are counted per trade and warned once per cause.
- marking.volatility?: 'current-quote' | 'entry'; default: not declared — `'current-quote'` (DEFAULT) re-marks each open leg from the exact current-snapshot contract
quote — its stated implied volatility, or one implied from the quote's selected price. `'entry'`
holds each leg's entry volatility for the whole trade (the pre-P1 behaviour, now explicit).
- periodsPerYear?: number; default: not declared — Annualization factor for the performance summary (default 252).
- quoteFreshness?: QuoteFreshnessPolicy; default: not declared — Refuse fills on stale quotes.
- quoteFreshness.maximumQuoteAgeMs: number; default: not declared
- riskFreeRate: number; default: not declared — Continuously-compounded risk-free rate (decimal) for every mark-to-market price and the
assignment carry. REQUIRED: a backtest that silently priced at 4% was a financial assumption
nobody stated.
- roll?: RollRule; default: not declared — Roll instead of closing flat when the rule fires.
- roll.when?: ExitRule; default: not declared — When to roll (defaults to the same triggers as {@link ExitRule}).
- roll.when.daysToExpiry?: number; default: not declared — Close at or below this many days to expiry.
- roll.when.profitTarget?: number; default: not declared — Close when captured P&L reaches this fraction of the entry premium (e.g. `0.5` = 50%).
- roll.when.stopLoss?: number; default: not declared — Close when the loss reaches this multiple of the entry premium (e.g. `2` = 200%).
- roll.when.when?: (context: ExitContext) => boolean; default: not declared — Arbitrary exit predicate (OR-combined with the declarative triggers).
- roll.when.when(context): ExitContext; default: not declared
- roll.when.when(context).asOf: number; default: not declared
- roll.when.when(context).daysToExpiry: number; default: not declared — Calendar days to expiry (nearest leg for a multi-expiry structure).
- roll.when.when(context).entryPremium: number; default: not declared — Signed entry premium (positive = net debit paid, negative = net credit received).
- roll.when.when(context).greeks: Greeks; default: not declared
- roll.when.when(context).markToMarket: number; default: not declared — Current mark-to-market P&L of the position, in account currency.
- roll.when.when(context).netDelta: number; default: not declared — Aggregate share-equivalent delta of the position.
- roll.when.when(context).pnlFraction: number; default: not declared — `mtm / |entryPremium|` — the fraction of the entry premium captured (+) or lost (−).
- roll.when.when(context).position: Position; default: not declared
- roll.when.when(context).snapshot: ChainSnapshot; default: not declared
- rules?: readonly EntryRule[]; default: not declared — Several rules at once (Stage 4.6): each a member of the book, entered in order at every snapshot.
- slippage?: SlippageModel; default: not declared — Slippage model for option trades (default none).
- slippage.fill: (input: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/costs').SlippageFillInput) => number; default: not declared
- slippage.fill(input): import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/costs').SlippageFillInput; default: not declared
- slippage.fill(input).quantity: number; default: not declared
- slippage.fill(input).referencePrice: number; default: not declared
- slippage.fill(input).side: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core').OrderSide; default: not declared

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/options#OptionsBacktestDiagnostics

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

```typescript
export interface OptionsBacktestDiagnostics extends Diagnostics {
    snapshotCount: number;
    tradeCount: number;
    openAtEnd: number;
    limitRejectionCount: number;
    fillRejectionCount: number;
    earlyAssignmentCount: number;
    corporateActionsApplied: number;
    /** The ledger's NAV minus the engine's equity at the worst mark — always 0 within 1e-6. */
    reconciliationResidual: number;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- autoReason?: string; default: not declared — When a meta-engine (e.g. `engines.auto()`) selected a delegate, this is a one-sentence,
human-readable explanation of WHY that delegate was chosen (`engine` then names the delegate).
Absent when no auto-selection took place.
- converged?: boolean; default: not declared — Whether an iterative procedure converged. `false` means the value is not trustworthy.
- corporateActionsApplied: number; default: not declared
- decomposition?: Record<string, number>; default: not declared — Named intermediate quantities the value decomposes into — a par spread's protection leg and
risky annuity, a forward variance's near/far legs. The H-series explain paths disclose their
arithmetic here so a caller can audit the ratio, not just receive it (3B.3).
- earlyAssignmentCount: number; default: not declared
- engine?: string; default: not declared — Pricing/solver engine name, e.g. `black-scholes-merton`.
- fillRejectionCount: number; default: not declared
- finiteDifferenceBumps?: Record<string, number>; default: not declared — Finite-difference engines: the ACTUAL bump sizes used for FD Greeks (spec P2.3) — adaptive
near the vol/time boundaries, so the caller can see exactly what was differenced.
Keys: `spotStep`, `volatilityStep`, `timeStepYears`, `rateStep`, and — extended Greeks only —
`dividendYieldStep`. Each is the actual step differenced, in the unit of the coordinate it
bumps. (This doc named the retired `hS`/`hSig`/`hT`/`hR`/`hQ` keys for one release after the
emit sites had moved to the semantic names, so a caller following it read `undefined`.)
- iterations?: number; default: not declared — Iteration count for iterative methods.
- limitRejectionCount: number; default: not declared
- method?: string; default: not declared — Numerical method, e.g. `closed-form`, `brent`, `finite-difference`.
- openAtEnd: number; default: not declared
- reconciliationResidual: number; default: not declared — The ledger's NAV minus the engine's equity at the worst mark — always 0 within 1e-6.
- selection?: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing').SelectionReport; default: not declared — The structured engine-selection report (Gate C, `@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing`): who was selected,
why, and — for automatic selection — every candidate considered with its verdict. This is the
machine-readable superset of `engine` + `autoReason` (which remain for compatibility);
`selected.name` always agrees with `engine` when both are present.
- selection.candidates?: readonly import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing').SelectionCandidate[]; default: not declared — Candidates an automatic selection considered; absent for explicit mode.
- selection.mode: 'explicit' | 'automatic'; default: not declared
- selection.reason: string; default: not declared — Why the selected engine answers this request.
- selection.selected: { name: string; version?: string; }; default: not declared
- selection.selected.name: string; default: not declared
- selection.selected.version?: string; default: not declared
- snapshotCount: number; default: not declared
- timingMs?: number; default: not declared — Wall-clock timing in milliseconds, when measured.
- tradeCount: number; default: not declared
- warmup?: number; default: not declared — Series facades: number of leading output slots that are warmup sentinels (null/NaN) while the
computation seeds. Equals the input length when the indicator never emitted.
- warnings: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core').QuantWarning[]; default: not declared — Structured warnings; always present (possibly empty).

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/options#OptionsTrade

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

One round-trip options trade in the backtest.

```typescript
/** One round-trip options trade in the backtest. */
export interface OptionsTrade {
    /** The structure as classified/constructed (e.g. `'bullPutSpread'`). */
    structure: string;
    entryAsOf: EpochMs;
    /** Exit time, or `null` if still open at the end of the run. */
    exitAsOf: EpochMs | null;
    expiry: string;
    contracts: number;
    /** Signed entry premium (positive = debit paid, negative = credit received), in account currency. */
    entryPremium: number;
    /** Realized P&L over the trade, net of costs, in account currency. */
    realizedPnl: number;
    /** Total commission + slippage paid on entry and exit. */
    costs: number;
    exitReason: ExitReason;
    perLeg: LegAttribution[];
    legs: readonly Leg[];
    /**
     * Greek P&L attribution of the trade's gross mark P&L (entry → exit), via `explainPositionPnl`. The
     * terms sum to `total` (≈ `realizedPnl + costs`); the `unexplained` residual is 3rd-order-and-higher.
     * See {@link TradePnlExplain}.
     */
    pnlExplain: TradePnlExplain;
    /** Where the trade's marks came from, counted over every open snapshot (Preview P1). */
    marks: TradeMarkCounts;
    /**
     * The volatility each leg was LAST marked at, aligned to `legs` — `null` for a stock leg or a leg
     * priced at intrinsic (expired/settled). Under `'current-quote'` this is the exit contract's
     * volatility; under `'entry'` it is the entry volatility.
     */
    exitVolatilities: (number | null)[];
    /** The book identity (Stage 4.6). */
    tradeId: number;
    ruleId: string;
    underlying: string;
    /** Ledger instrument ids aligned to `legs` (OCC symbols for options, the underlying for stock). */
    legInstrumentIds: string[];
    /** Corporate actions applied while the trade was open, oldest first. */
    lineage: TradeLineage[];
    /** True when a legged fill held fewer legs than the structure names. */
    partial: boolean;
    unfilledLegs: UnfilledLeg[];
    /** Legs settled before the trade closed (a calendar's near leg, an early assignment), aligned to `legs` by `legIndex`. */
    legSettlements: Array<{
        legIndex: number;
        settlement: OptionSettlement;
    }>;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- contracts: number; default: not declared
- costs: number; default: not declared — Total commission + slippage paid on entry and exit.
- entryAsOf: number; default: not declared

- exitVolatilities: (number | null)[]; default: not declared — The volatility each leg was LAST marked at, aligned to `legs` — `null` for a stock leg or a leg

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/options#TradePnlExplain

Kind: type; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

A closed trade's **greek P&L explain** (entry → exit): the realized gross mark P&L decomposed into
greek contributions (the full 2nd-order Taylor + dividend carry) plus an honest `unexplained`
residual, via `@insiderfinance/totalfinance/risk`'s `explainPositionPnl`. These are the **bare terms** —
the backtest result carries the report envelope (`assumptions`/`diagnostics`) at the top level, so a
per-trade row stays a plain record (matching `perLeg`). The terms sum exactly to `total`, which is
anchored to the trade's gross (pre-cost) P&L: `total === realizedPnl + costs`. (The day-0 entry edge —
fill vs. model mark — is a model/data effect, so it lives in `unexplained`, not a greek term.)

Under the default `'current-quote'` marking (Preview P1) each leg is re-marked from its current
contract quote, so `vega` (with `vanna`/`vomma`/`veta`) is a live term attributed per leg from the
entry volatility to the exit volatility; under `marking.volatility: 'entry'` the leg volatility is
held for the trade and those terms stay ~0. The rate is held fixed across the trade. See
`explainPositionPnl` for the per-leg vol-attribution contract.

```typescript
/**
 * A closed trade's **greek P&L explain** (entry → exit): the realized gross mark P&L decomposed into
 * greek contributions (the full 2nd-order Taylor + dividend carry) plus an honest `unexplained`
 * residual, via `@insiderfinance/totalfinance/risk`'s `explainPositionPnl`. These are the **bare terms** —
 * the backtest result carries the report envelope (`assumptions`/`diagnostics`) at the top level, so a
 * per-trade row stays a plain record (matching `perLeg`). The terms sum exactly to `total`, which is
 * anchored to the trade's gross (pre-cost) P&L: `total === realizedPnl + costs`. (The day-0 entry edge —
 * fill vs. model mark — is a model/data effect, so it lives in `unexplained`, not a greek term.)
 *
 * Under the default `'current-quote'` marking (Preview P1) each leg is re-marked from its current
 * contract quote, so `vega` (with `vanna`/`vomma`/`veta`) is a live term attributed per leg from the
 * entry volatility to the exit volatility; under `marking.volatility: 'entry'` the leg volatility is
 * held for the trade and those terms stay ~0. The rate is held fixed across the trade. See
 * `explainPositionPnl` for the per-leg vol-attribution contract.
 */
export type TradePnlExplain = Omit<PnlExplain, 'assumptions' | 'diagnostics'>;
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- charm: number; default: not declared — Second-order spot–time cross term: `charm·dS·dt` (0 unless the greeks carry `charm`).
- delta: number; default: not declared — Delta term: `Δ·dS`.
- deltaRate: number; default: not declared — Second-order spot–rate cross term: `deltaRate·dS·dr` (0 unless the greeks carry `deltaRate`).
- gamma: number; default: not declared — Gamma term: `½Γ·dS²`.
- phi: number; default: not declared — First-order dividend-carry term: `φ·dq` (0 unless the greeks carry `phi`).
- rho: number; default: not declared — Rho term: `Rho·dr`.
- rhoConvexity: number; default: not declared — Second-order rate-convexity term: `½·rhoConvexity·dr²` (0 unless the greeks carry `rhoConvexity`).
- theta: number; default: not declared — Theta term: `Θ·dt`.
- thetaConvexity: number; default: not declared — Second-order time-convexity term: `½·thetaConvexity·dt²` (0 unless the greeks carry `thetaConvexity`).
- thetaRate: number; default: not declared — Second-order time–rate cross term: `thetaRate·dt·dr` (0 unless the greeks carry `thetaRate`).
- total: number; default: not declared — The actual realized P&L.
- unexplained: number; default: not declared — `total − Σ(terms)` — the full 2nd-order Taylor in (spot, vol, time, rate) plus the dividend carry
is now attributed, so the residual is only 3rd-order-and-higher (speed/ultima/…), any 2nd-order
greek the caller did not supply, and model/data. Grows as the greek expansion breaks.
- vanna: number; default: not declared — Second-order spot–vol cross term: `vanna·dS·dσ` (0 unless the greeks carry `vanna`).
- vega: number; default: not declared — Vega term: `Vega·dσ`.
- vera: number; default: not declared — Second-order vol–rate cross term: `vera·dσ·dr` (0 unless the greeks carry `vera`).
- veta: number; default: not declared — Second-order vol–time cross term: `veta·dσ·dt` (0 unless the greeks carry `veta`).
- vomma: number; default: not declared — Second-order vol-convexity term: `½·vomma·dσ²` (0 unless the greeks carry `vomma`).

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/options#UnfilledLeg

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

A leg a legged fill could not fill, with why.

```typescript
/** A leg a legged fill could not fill, with why. */

    leg: Leg;
    cause: 'missing' | 'ambiguous' | 'stale' | 'unpriceable';
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- cause: 'stale' | 'missing' | 'ambiguous' | 'unpriceable'; default: not declared
- leg: Leg; default: not declared
- leg.expiry?: (string) | (undefined); default: not declared — Optional per-leg expiry (`YYYY-MM-DD` → 16:00 ET, or a full datetime). When omitted the leg uses
the position-level expiry supplied to `value()`. Set it for multi-expiry structures (calendars,
diagonals, double diagonals) so each leg is priced at its own time-to-expiry.
- leg.impliedVolatility?: (number) | (undefined); default: not declared — Optional per-leg implied volatility (decimal, e.g. `0.28`). When set, `value()`/`chartData()`/

Never on an option row (a stock row's entry price).
- leg.quantity: number; default: not declared — Signed shares: positive = long, negative = short.
Signed contracts: positive = long, negative = short.
- leg.strike?: (number) | (undefined); default: not declared — Never on a stock row (typed so a union read narrows to `undefined`, not to a fake 0).

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/paper#CreatePaperBrokerInput

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

```typescript
export interface CreatePaperBrokerInput {
    /**
     * The declared execution reality; default `execution.simplified()`. Restoring requires the same
     * declared data, callback labels and fill-model version as every submission in the journal.
     * Callbacks cannot serialize: callers must supply the original implementations and change their
     * declared identity when their behavior changes; the broker cannot verify captured closure state.
     */
    execution?: ExecutionPolicy;
    /** The ledger's base currency — prices an instrument `instruments` does not describe. The broker never holds the ledger: the caller applies the events it returns. */
    baseCurrency: string;
    /**
     * Complete prior paper journal, folded at construction. Submitted context and normalized fills
     * are required; incomplete legacy journals fail explicitly and need migration from original facts.
     * Restore, operate and persist must be one caller-owned transaction for concurrent processes.
     * The journal preserves halt's cancellations, NOT the in-memory halt flag. A durable account-wide
     * kill switch requires an external persisted execution gate (including when there are no orders).
     */
    journal?: readonly ExecutionJournalEvent[];
    /** The `sourceId` every journal event and ledger fill carries — `paper:<account>` by convention. */
    sourceId: string;
    accountId: string;
    /** Instrument terms by id for new orders; absent = plain cash in base currency. Restored orders use their persisted terms; conflicting supplied terms are refused. */
    instruments?: Readonly<Record<string, PaperInstrument>>;
}
```

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/paper#PaperBroker

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

```typescript
export interface PaperBroker {
    submit(input: PaperSubmitInput): ExecutionReceipt;
    step(input: PaperStepInput): PaperStepResult;
    cancel(input: PaperCancelInput): PaperCancelResult;
    deliver(input: PaperDeliverInput): PaperDeliverResult;
    halt(input: PaperHaltInput): PaperHaltResult;
    /** Clears this instance's halt only; never reopens the cancelled orders. */
    resume(input: {
        now: EpochMs;
    }): {
        halted: false;
    };
    /** The append-only journal so far (a frozen copy). */
    journal(): ExecutionJournalEvent[];
    /** The folded journal state (a frozen copy). */
    state(): ExecutionJournalState;
    /** Open (non-terminal) order states in id order. */
    openOrders(): ExecutionOrderState[];
    /** Every receipt issued, in submission order. */
    receipts(): ExecutionReceipt[];
    describe(): PaperBrokerDescription;
}
```

- step: (input: PaperStepInput) => PaperStepResult; default: not declared
- step().return.asOf: number; default: not declared

- step().return.expired: string[]; default: not declared

- step().return.journal: ExecutionJournalEvent[]; default: not declared
- step().return.open: string[]; default: not declared — Orders still open after the step.
- step().return.unfilled: { orderId: string; reason: UnfilledReason | 'already-observed' | 'observation-before-submission' | 'combo-leg-unfilled' | 'combo-net-limit'; detail: string; }[]; default: not declared — Why an open order did not fill this step. `already-observed`: the observation is not newer than
the last one this order consumed. `observation-before-submission` (B6): the observation predates
the submission. `combo-leg-unfilled` / `combo-net-limit` (B5): a combo fills all-or-none against
one observation instant, and only when its net price per combo unit meets the limit.
- step(input): PaperStepInput; default: not declared
- step(input).asOf: number; default: not declared — Decision time, at or after submission/latest order event and every supplied observation (an
already-consumed observation may be retried at its original instant and is a no-op). Day
orders expire after 24 hours from acceptance when expireAtSessionClose is enabled; no exchange
calendar/session-close lookup is performed by paper.
- step(input).observations: Readonly<Record<string, MarketObservation>>; default: not declared — The observation each open instrument meets; missing instruments stay open. After a fill, only
a strictly newer observation timestamp may fill that order again (including across restarts).
Repeating or revising a consumed timestamp cannot consume its liquidity again. An observation
older than the order's submission never fills it (B6). Results contain only NEW fills;
previously returned accounting facts remain in journal detail.fill for recovery.

- submit().return.diagnostics.engine: 'paper-broker'; default: not declared

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/paper#PaperStepInput

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

```typescript
export interface PaperStepInput {
    /**
     * The observation each open instrument meets; missing instruments stay open. After a fill, only
     * a strictly newer observation timestamp may fill that order again (including across restarts).
     * Repeating or revising a consumed timestamp cannot consume its liquidity again. An observation
     * older than the order's submission never fills it (B6). Results contain only NEW fills;
     * previously returned accounting facts remain in journal detail.fill for recovery.
     */
    observations: Readonly<Record<string, MarketObservation>>;
    /** Decision time, at or after submission/latest order event and every supplied observation (an
     * already-consumed observation may be retried at its original instant and is a no-op). Day
     * orders expire after 24 hours from acceptance when expireAtSessionClose is enabled; no exchange
     * calendar/session-close lookup is performed by paper. */
    asOf: EpochMs;
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- asOf: number; default: not declared — Decision time, at or after submission/latest order event and every supplied observation (an
already-consumed observation may be retried at its original instant and is a no-op). Day
orders expire after 24 hours from acceptance when expireAtSessionClose is enabled; no exchange
calendar/session-close lookup is performed by paper.
- observations: Readonly<Record<string, MarketObservation>>; default: not declared — The observation each open instrument meets; missing instruments stay open. After a fill, only
a strictly newer observation timestamp may fill that order again (including across restarts).
Repeating or revising a consumed timestamp cannot consume its liquidity again. An observation
older than the order's submission never fills it (B6). Results contain only NEW fills;
previously returned accounting facts remain in journal detail.fill for recovery.

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/paper#PaperStepResult

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

```typescript
export interface PaperStepResult {
    asOf: EpochMs;
    fills: NormalizedFill[];
    /** The ledger events for the fills (`portfolioEventsFromFill`) — the caller applies them. */
    events: PortfolioEventEnvelope[];
    journal: ExecutionJournalEvent[];
    expired: string[];
    /**
     * Why an open order did not fill this step. `already-observed`: the observation is not newer than
     * the last one this order consumed. `observation-before-submission` (B6): the observation predates
     * the submission. `combo-leg-unfilled` / `combo-net-limit` (B5): a combo fills all-or-none against
     * one observation instant, and only when its net price per combo unit meets the limit.
     */

        orderId: string;
        reason: UnfilledReason | 'already-observed' | 'observation-before-submission' | 'combo-leg-unfilled' | 'combo-net-limit';
        detail: string;
    }[];
    /** Orders still open after the step. */
    open: string[];
}
```

- expired: string[]; default: not declared
- fills: NormalizedFill[]; default: not declared
- journal: ExecutionJournalEvent[]; default: not declared
- open: string[]; default: not declared — Orders still open after the step.
- unfilled: { orderId: string; reason: UnfilledReason | 'already-observed' | 'observation-before-submission' | 'combo-leg-unfilled' | 'combo-net-limit'; detail: string; }[]; default: not declared — Why an open order did not fill this step. `already-observed`: the observation is not newer than
the last one this order consumed. `observation-before-submission` (B6): the observation predates

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/backtest/paper#createPaperBroker

Kind: function; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

Build the paper broker over a declared execution policy and a ledger's account. Every method is
explicit about time (`now` / `asOf`), every journal write folds through the transition table,
every fill is a `NormalizedFill` the ledger folds unchanged, and a retry is never a second order.

```typescript
export declare function createPaperBroker(input: CreatePaperBrokerInput): PaperBroker;
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- (input): CreatePaperBrokerInput; default: not declared
- (input).accountId: string; default: not declared
- (input).baseCurrency: string; default: not declared — The ledger's base currency — prices an instrument `instruments` does not describe. The broker never holds the ledger: the caller applies the events it returns.
- (input).execution?: ExecutionPolicy; default: not declared — The declared execution reality; default `execution.simplified()`. Restoring requires the same
declared data, callback labels and fill-model version as every submission in the journal.
Callbacks cannot serialize: callers must supply the original implementations and change their
declared identity when their behavior changes; the broker cannot verify captured closure state.
- (input).instruments?: Readonly<Record<string, PaperInstrument>>; default: not declared — Instrument terms by id for new orders; absent = plain cash in base currency. Restored orders use their persisted terms; conflicting supplied terms are refused.
- (input).journal?: readonly ExecutionJournalEvent[]; default: not declared — Complete prior paper journal, folded at construction. Submitted context and normalized fills
are required; incomplete legacy journals fail explicitly and need migration from original facts.
Restore, operate and persist must be one caller-owned transaction for concurrent processes.
The journal preserves halt's cancellations, NOT the in-memory halt flag. A durable account-wide
kill switch requires an external persisted execution gate (including when there are no orders).
- (input).sourceId: string; default: not declared — The `sourceId` every journal event and ledger fill carries — `paper:<account>` by convention.
- return.cancel: (input: PaperCancelInput) => PaperCancelResult; default: not declared
- return.deliver: (input: PaperDeliverInput) => PaperDeliverResult; default: not declared
- return.describe: () => PaperBrokerDescription; default: not declared
- return.halt: (input: PaperHaltInput) => PaperHaltResult; default: not declared
- return.journal: () => ExecutionJournalEvent[]; default: not declared — The append-only journal so far (a frozen copy).
- return.openOrders: () => ExecutionOrderState[]; default: not declared — Open (non-terminal) order states in id order.
- return.receipts: () => ExecutionReceipt[]; default: not declared — Every receipt issued, in submission order.
- return.resume: (input: { now: EpochMs; }) => { halted: false; }; default: not declared — Clears this instance's halt only; never reopens the cancelled orders.
- return.state: () => ExecutionJournalState; default: not declared — The folded journal state (a frozen copy).
- return.step: (input: PaperStepInput) => PaperStepResult; default: not declared
- return.submit: (input: PaperSubmitInput) => ExecutionReceipt; default: not declared

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- autoReason?: string; default: not declared — When a meta-engine (e.g. `engines.auto()`) selected a delegate, this is a one-sentence,
human-readable explanation of WHY that delegate was chosen (`engine` then names the delegate).
Absent when no auto-selection took place.
- converged?: boolean; default: not declared — Whether an iterative procedure converged. `false` means the value is not trustworthy.
- decomposition?: Record<string, number>; default: not declared — Named intermediate quantities the value decomposes into — a par spread's protection leg and
risky annuity, a forward variance's near/far legs. The H-series explain paths disclose their
arithmetic here so a caller can audit the ratio, not just receive it (3B.3).
- engine?: string; default: not declared — Pricing/solver engine name, e.g. `black-scholes-merton`.
- externalFlowCount: number; default: not declared
- fillCount: number; default: not declared
- finiteDifferenceBumps?: Record<string, number>; default: not declared — Finite-difference engines: the ACTUAL bump sizes used for FD Greeks (spec P2.3) — adaptive
near the vol/time boundaries, so the caller can see exactly what was differenced.
Keys: `spotStep`, `volatilityStep`, `timeStepYears`, `rateStep`, and — extended Greeks only —
`dividendYieldStep`. Each is the actual step differenced, in the unit of the coordinate it
bumps. (This doc named the retired `hS`/`hSig`/`hT`/`hR`/`hQ` keys for one release after the
emit sites had moved to the semantic names, so a caller following it read `undefined`.)
- iterations?: number; default: not declared — Iteration count for iterative methods.
- lifecycleEventCount: number; default: not declared
- liquidationCount: number; default: not declared
- markCount: number; default: not declared
- method?: string; default: not declared — Numerical method, e.g. `closed-form`, `brent`, `finite-difference`.
- orderCount: number; default: not declared
- reconciliationResidual: number; default: not declared — The ledger NAV minus the engine's equity at the worst mark — always 0 within 1e-6.
- rejectionCount: number; default: not declared
- selection?: import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing').SelectionReport; default: not declared — The structured engine-selection report (Gate C, `@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing`): who was selected,
why, and — for automatic selection — every candidate considered with its verdict. This is the
machine-readable superset of `engine` + `autoReason` (which remain for compatibility);
`selected.name` always agrees with `engine` when both are present.
- selection.candidates?: readonly import('@insiderfinance/totalfinance/core/pricing').SelectionCandidate[]; default: not declared — Candidates an automatic selection considered; absent for explicit mode.
- selection.mode: 'explicit' | 'automatic'; default: not declared

- selection.selected.name: string; default: not declared
- selection.selected.version?: string; default: not declared
- sessionCount: number; default: not declared

- warmup?: number; default: not declared — Series facades: number of leading output slots that are warmup sentinels (null/NaN) while the
computation seeds. Equals the input length when the indicator never emitted.

```typescript
    /** `quantity × mark × multiplier` in the base currency, signed; null while the instrument has no mark (Stage 7B.1). */

    /** The mark per unit at the instant, or `null` when unavailable. */
    markPricePerUnit: number | null;
    currency: string;
}
```

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/calendars#tradingDaysToExpiry

Kind: function; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

Trading sessions remaining until an expiry — the days-to-expiry number traders scale
volatility with (`√(tradingDays / 252)`), counted on THIS calendar's actual schedule
rather than calendar days ÷ 7 × 5.

Counts trading sessions in `(from, expiry]`: the `from` date itself is excluded (it is
already underway), the expiry date is included when it is a trading day. Same-day expiry
→ `0`. An `expiry` before `from` is a typed error, never a negative count.

```typescript
export declare function tradingDaysToExpiry(calendar: Calendar, from: string, expiry: string): number;
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- (calendar): Calendar; default: not declared
- (calendar).addBusinessDays: (date: string, days: number) => string; default: not declared
- (calendar).businessDaysBetween: (from: string, to: string) => number; default: not declared — Business days in the half-open interval `(from, to]` (negative if `to < from`).
- (calendar).isBusinessDay: (date: string) => boolean; default: not declared
- (calendar).isHalfDay: (date: string) => boolean; default: not declared
- (calendar).isHoliday: (date: string) => boolean; default: not declared
- (calendar).name: string; default: not declared

- (calendar).previousBusinessDay: (date: string) => string; default: not declared

the CLI guide's table are checked against the same values.

```typescript
export declare const CLI_EXIT_CODES: Readonly<{ readonly success: 0; readonly usage: 2; readonly inputRefused: 3; readonly operationFailed: 4; readonly jobCancelled: 5; readonly internal: 70; }>;
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- inputRefused: 3; default: not declared — The input was refused — an `OperationError` with an `input.*` code.
- internal: 70; default: not declared — An internal error (a bug, a missing worker build) — never an input problem.
- jobCancelled: 5; default: not declared — The job was cancelled before it produced a result.
- operationFailed: 4; default: not declared — The operation failed — any other `OperationError`.
- success: 0; default: not declared — The command succeeded; stdout carries one JSON document.
- usage: 2; default: not declared — Usage: an unknown command or flag, a missing argument, a malformed `--input`, an environment below the floor.

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/cli#SubmitJobInput

Kind: interface; stability: preview (pre-1.0).

```typescript
export interface SubmitJobInput {
    registry: OperationRegistry;
    jobs: JobStore;
    artifacts: ArtifactStore;
    /** The store directory a worker reopens (file stores are shared by path). */
    directory: string;
    id: string;
    input: unknown;
    /** The profile (and optional pack narrowing) the worker rebuilds the registry from. */
    profile: RegistryProfile;
    packs?: readonly string[];
    /** The caller's clock: stamps `submittedAt`, handles, and every transition. */
    clock: () => string;
    /** A job id; omitted ⇒ `job-<inputsHash prefix>-<submittedAt digits>`. */
    jobId?: string;
    seed?: number;
    maxInputBytes?: number;
    deadlineMs?: number;
    inlineResultBytes?: number;
    /** How often the runner re-reads the store for an external cancel (ms, default 250). */
    pollMs?: number;
}
```

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/commodities#RollReturnDecompositionResult

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

Result of {@link rollReturnDecomposition}.

```typescript
/** Result of {@link rollReturnDecomposition}. */
export interface RollReturnDecompositionResult {
    /**
     * The OBSERVED total return on the held contract over the holding period:
     * `finalContractPriceBeforeRoll / initialContractPrice − 1`.
     */
    totalHoldingReturn: number;
    /** `finalSpotPrice / initialSpotPrice − 1` — the spot move over the period. */
    spotMoveReturn: number;
    /**
     * The change in the contract's basis ratio to spot over the period:
     * `(finalContractPriceBeforeRoll / finalSpotPrice) / (initialContractPrice / initialSpotPrice) − 1`
     * — the carry/convergence earned as the contract pulls toward spot (positive for a long in
     * backwardation).
     */
    carryConvergenceReturn: number;
    /**
     * The roll leg, stated SEPARATELY: the roll is cash-neutral at execution, so its yield
     * `(finalContractPriceBeforeRoll − nextContractPriceAtRoll) / nextContractPriceAtRoll` accrues
     * over the NEXT holding period and is never added into `totalHoldingReturn`.
     */
    rollLeg: {
        rollYieldFraction: number;
        /** The fixed roll-leg prose: cash-neutral at execution, accrues next period. */
        convention: string;
    };
    assumptions: {
        /** The fixed reconciliation prose: the components compound exactly to the observed total. */
        reconciliation: string;
        declaredResidualBound: 1e-12;
    };
    diagnostics: {
        warnings: string[];
        /** `(1 + totalHoldingReturn) − (1 + spotMoveReturn) × (1 + carryConvergenceReturn)` — floating point only. */
        reconciliationResidual: number;
    };
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- assumptions: { declaredResidualBound: 1e-12; reconciliation: string; }; default: not declared
- assumptions.declaredResidualBound: 1e-12; default: not declared
- assumptions.reconciliation: string; default: not declared — The fixed reconciliation prose: the components compound exactly to the observed total.

- diagnostics.warnings: string[]; default: not declared
- rollLeg: { convention: string; rollYieldFraction: number; }; default: not declared — The roll leg, stated SEPARATELY: the roll is cash-neutral at execution, so its yield

### @insiderfinance/totalfinance/commodities#RollYieldResult

Kind: interface; stability: stable-by-law (pre-1.0; not a 1.0 stability guarantee).

Result of {@link rollYield}.

```typescript
/** Result of {@link rollYield}. */
export interface RollYieldResult {
    /**
     * `(expiringContractPrice − nextContractPrice) / nextContractPrice` — the yield a long roller
     * locks in for the next holding period under a static curve. SIGN LAW: positive in
     * backwardation (next below expiring), negative in contango.
     */
    rollYieldFraction: number;
    /**
     * Spot-relative decomposition, present exactly when `spotPriceAtRoll` was supplied. The two
     * components COMPOUND (they do not sum): with `e = expiringVersusSpotFraction` and
     * `n = nextVersusSpotFraction`, `(1 + rollYieldFraction) = (1 + e) / (1 + n)` EXACTLY — an
     * algebraic identity, since `(E/S) / (N/S) = E/N`.
     */
    decomposition?: {
        /**
         * `(expiringContractPrice − spotPriceAtRoll) / spotPriceAtRoll` — the expiring contract's
         * residual basis to spot (near zero when rolled at expiry; the carry already converged).
         */
        expiringVersusSpotFraction: number;
        /**
         * `(nextContractPrice − spotPriceAtRoll) / spotPriceAtRoll` — the curve slope out to the next
         * contract; NEGATIVE in backwardation, which is exactly where positive roll yield comes from.
         */
        nextVersusSpotFraction: number;
    };
    /** Present exactly when the decomposition is absent — the reason, never a guessed spot. */
    decompositionAbsentReason?: string;
    assumptions: {
        /** The fixed direction prose: a long roller out of the expiring contract into the next. */
        rollDirection: string;
        /** The fixed sign-law prose: positive in backwardation, negative in contango. */
        signLaw: string;
        /** The fixed decomposition prose: the spot-relative components compound exactly. */
        decompositionConvention: string;
    };
    diagnostics: {
        warnings: string[];
    };
}
```

Members/parameters (default = JSDoc only; not declared means no documented default):

- assumptions: { decompositionConvention: string; rollDirection: string; signLaw: string; }; default: not declared
- assumptions.decompositionConvention: string; default: not declared — The fixed decomposition prose: the spot-relative components compound exactly.
- assumptions.rollDirection: string; default: not declared — The fixed direction prose: a long roller out of the expiring contract into the next.
- assumptions.signLaw: string; default: not declared — The fixed sign-law prose: positive in backwardation, negative in contango.
- decomposition?: { expiringVersusSpotFraction: number; nextVersusSpotFraction: number; }; default: not declared — Spot-relative decomposition, present exactly when `spotPriceAtRoll` was supplied. The two
components COMPOUND (they do not sum): with `e = expiringVersusSpotFraction` and
`n = nextVersusSpotFraction`, `(1 + rollYieldFraction) = (1 + e) / (1 + n)` EXACTLY — an
algebraic identity, since `(E/S) / (N/S) = E/N`.
- decomposition.expiringVersusSpotFraction: number; default: not declared — `(expiringContractPrice − spotPriceAtRoll) / spotPriceAtRoll` — the expiring contract's
residual basis to spot (near zero when rolled at expiry; the carry already converged).
- decomposition.nextVersusSpotFraction: number; default: not declared — `(nextContractPrice − spotPriceAtRoll) / spotPriceAtRoll` — the curve slope out to the next
contract; NEGATIVE in backwardation, which is exactly where positive roll yield comes from.
- decompositionAbsentReason?: string; default: not declared — Present exactly when the decomposition is absent — the reason, never a guessed spot.
- diagnostics: { warnings: string[]; }; default: not declared
- diagnostics.warnings: string[]; default: not declared
- rollYieldFraction: number; default: not declared — `(expiringContractPrice − nextContractPrice) / nextContractPrice` — the yield a long roller
locks in for the next holding period under a static curve. SIGN LAW: positive in
backwardation (next below expiring), negative in contango.
